note: All 10 samas are fully populated and sourced. Original owi text and Marathi meaning from the ioustotra.blogspot.com 'Stotra (hymns)' blog (Prakash Ketkar); English meaning from John Norwell's 2015 translation. Every samas's owi count matches exactly between both independent sources with no gaps, duplicates, or numbering shifts, and no parser issues were flagged for this dashak. This dashak covers desirelessness, alms-begging, the art of poetry, kirtan, harikatha, cleverness, the dharma of the ages, uninterrupted meditation, the eternal, and maya.

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ऐका निस्पृहाची सिकवण । युक्ति बुद्धि शाहाणपण । जेणें राहे समाधान । निरंतर ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निस्पृह पुरुषाचे गुण कोणते तें आतां ऐका. ज्यामुळें मनाचे समाधान निरंतर टिकते. ती युक्ति, बुद्धि आणि शहाणपणाची स्थिती पुढीलप्रमाणें असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Listen to the teaching of the desireless and detached. It is the wisdom of a skilful buddhi, for it understands this secret `art' of knowing. Then due to this mula maya, there is the complete contentment that is void of this inner space (ie. beyond mula maya).

owis.original: सोपा मंत्र परी नेमस्त । साधे वोषध गुणवंत । साधें बोलणें सप्रचीत । तैसें माझें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा मंत्र सोपा असतो परंतु खात्रीनें फळ देतो किंवा एखादे औषध साधे असते पण निश्र्चित गुण देते. त्याचप्रमाणें माझे बोलणे साधें आहे पण तें स्वानुभवाचे आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: It is this easy mantra `I am'. But this `I am' is limited. Still due to this medicine, there is that One who possess this guna (within this medicine of `I am' there is that mula purush). Due to this pure `speech' of mine, there is this true `experience' (`everywhere, in everything, I am there').

owis.original: तत्काळचि अवगुण जाती । उत्तम गुणाची प्राप्ती । शब्दवोषध तीव्र श्रोतीं । साक्षपें सेवावें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माझें बोलणें जर नीट ऐकलें तर अवगुण बघतां बघतां नाहींसे होतात. आणि उत्तम गुण अंगी जडतात. माझें बोलणें कडक औषधासारखें आहे. श्रोत्यांनी तें प्रयत्नपूर्वक ऐकावें.
owis.englishMeaning: If the listener to this `speech' is earnest then, by the remedy of this `word', the worst gunas (ie. mixed gunas of body consciousness) are destroyed and that best guna is attained.

owis.original: निस्पृहता धरुं नये । धरिली तरी सोडूं नये । सोडिली तरी हिंडों नये । वोळखीमधें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आधीं निःस्पृहता धरुं नये. पण जर धरली तर ती सोडूं नये. आणी जर ती सोडली तर ओळखीच्या लोकांत वावरु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who is desireless should never hold anything in the mind and then that which is held should never be left* (when nothing is there then, He remains). And having left all, one should never again wander within that which is known (never wander in this world of many objects). *(maharaj- one should know what to hold and what not to hold)

owis.original: कांता दृष्टी राखों नये । मनास गोडी चाखऊं नये । धारिष्ट चळतां दाखऊं नये । मुख आपुलें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायकांच्याकडे डोळे भरुन पाहूं नये. कामवासनेच्या तृप्तीची गोडी मनाला लावूं नये. त्या बाबतींत आपलें मनसंयमन तुटलें तर लोकांना तोंड दाखवूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not have eyes for women* and the mind should not have the preference for only pleasure and beauty. If your courage/forbearance leaves you, then you will not be allowed to see your own true form/face. *(maharaj- you see a woman and the Master sees brahman)

owis.original: येके स्थळीं राहों नये । कानकोंडें साहों नये । द्रव्य दारा पाहों नये । आळकेपणें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका ठिकाणी फार दिवस राहूं नये. कोणाचे मिंधेपण सहसा करुं नये. पैसा आणि बायका यांच्याकडे आशाळभूत होऊन पाहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The One should not stay in any place and therefore be everywhere. One should not live in a way that brings insults (living as a body brings praise and insult). Wealth and woman should not be looked at with longing.

owis.original: आचारभ्रष्ट होऊं नये । दिल्यां द्रव्य घेऊं नये । उणा शब्द येऊं नये । आपणावरी ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आचारानें भ्रष्ट होऊं नये. कोणी द्रव्य दिल्यास तें घेऊं नये. कोणाचा उणा शब्द आपल्याकडे न येईल असेंच वागावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not be this delusional conduct. One should not accept any wealth that can be given (ie. the wealth of the `many'. One should accept the wealth of understanding). One should not let lowly words come upon you (you are aum, the superior `word').

owis.original: भिक्षेविषीं लाजों नये । बहुत भिक्षा घेऊं नये । पुसतांहि देऊं नये । वोळखी आपली ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षा मागण्यास लाजूं नये. भिक्षासुद्धा थोडी घ्यावी. कोणी चौकशी केली तर स्वतःबद्दल माहिती सांगू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not be ashamed to ask for alms but this `all' should not accept these alms (maharaj- for this body only I have to beg). You should wipe yourself away and not give yourself recognition.

owis.original: धड मळिण नेसों नये । गोडअन्न खाऊं नये । दुराग्रह करुं नये । प्रसंगे वर्तावें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वस्त्र धड असावें मलिन असूं नये. गोड अन्न खाऊं नये. उगाच दुराग्रह नसावा व प्रसंग पाहून वागावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not wear the dirty clothes (ie. gross body) and the divine `food' should not be consumed (the `I am' should not be forgotten). One should not be egotistical and opinionated but behave according to this connection of the `all'.

owis.original: भोगीं मन असों नये । देहदुःखें त्रासों नये । पुढें आशा धरुं नये । जीवित्वाची ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सुख भोगावयास मिळावें असें मनांत असूं नये. देहदुःखाला कंटाळू नये. आपण आणखी जगावें अशी आशा धरुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not hope for sensual enjoyment and not be upset by bodily suffering. And later, one should not even have the desire to live (ie. I do not exist). (maharaj you should not have the desire for life even)

owis.original: विरक्ती गळों देऊं नये । धारिष्ट चळों देऊं नये । ज्ञान मळिण होऊं नये । विवेकबळें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपलें वैराग्य सांभाळून असावें. आपलें धैर्य खचूं देऊं नये. विवेकाच्या सामर्थ्यानें आपलें ज्ञान नेहमी ताजें ठेवावें, मलिन होऊं देवूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not let desirelessness be lost nor let such courage be broken. By deter- mined vivek, this knowledge should not be sullied.

owis.original: करुणाकीर्तन सोडूं नये । अंतर्ध्यान मोडूं नये । प्रेमतंतु तोडूं नये । सगुणमूर्तीचा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किर्तनामध्यें देवाची करुणा भाकावी. अंतःकरणांतील भगवंताचे ध्यान कधीं मोडूं नये. सगुणमूर्तीचा प्रेमसंबंध कधीं सोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not leave the earnest singing of God's song. One should not let that inner meditation be broken. One should not break the bond of love with God in His sagun form (ie. `I am everywhere').

owis.original: पोटीं चिंता धरुं नये । कष्टें खेद मानूं नये । समइं धीर सांडूं नये । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनामध्यें कशाची चिंता करुं नये. कष्ट पडले तर दुःख करुं नये. प्रसंग पडला असतां वाटेल तें झालें तरी धीर सोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not worry for the belly nor grieve over suffering. At these times you should not lose your valour and become this created `thing' (be that detached purush and not His prakruti).

owis.original: अपमानिता सिणों नये । निखंदिता कष्टों नये । धिःकारितां झुरों नये । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी अपमान केला तर नाराज होऊं नये. कोणी वर्म काढून बोललें तरी तें मनाला लावून घेऊं नये. कोणी तुच्छ लेखिलें तरी त्यामुळें झुरु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not grieve when disregarded nor be troubled by criticism. Even when being scorned, do not slip away and be this created `thing'.

owis.original: लोकलाज धरुं नये । लाजवितां लाजों नये । खिजवितां खिजों नये । विरक्त पुरुषें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भकतीच लोक लाज बाळगूं नये. कोणी लाजवण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तरी त्यास बळी पडूं नये. कोणी चिडवण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तरी विरक्त पुरुषानें चिडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not care for this world of shame nor should one feel ashamed when shamed. The desireless purush should not insult even when insulted.

owis.original: शुद्धमार्ग सोडूं नये । दुर्जनासीं तंडों नये । समंध पडों देऊं नये । चांडाळासी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नेहमीं शुद्ध मार्गानेंच जावें. दुर्जनांशीं भांडण करुं नये. अति दुष्ट माणसाशी संबंध टाळावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The path of the pure should not be left and one should not quarrel with the one far from the Self. One should avoid making any relationship with the chandala caste (ie. the lowest caste that work with leather ie. to be a body)

owis.original: तपीळपण धरुं नये । भांडवितां भांडों नये । उडवितां उडऊं नये । निजस्थिती आपुली ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंगीं तापटपणा नसावा. कोणी भांडण करण्याच्या भरीला घातलें तरी आपण भांडूं नये. आपलें स्वरुपानुसंधान भ्रष्ट करण्याचा कोणी प्रयत्न केला तरी तें जसेंच्या तसें टिकवून धरावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not hold one's anger. One should not quarrel with the quarrelsome mind. One should not lose one's own steady state amongst the scattered and confused thoughts.

owis.original: हांसवितां हासों नये । बोलवितां बोलों नये । चालवितां चालों नये । क्षणश्र्णा ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी हसवण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तरी हंसूं नये. कोणी मुद्दाम बोलवण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तरी बोलूं नये. कोणी इकडे चला तिकडे चला असें म्हणून क्षणाक्षणाला चालवूं लागला तरी तसें करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not laugh, if made to laugh. One should not `speak', if made to `speak', one should not move, when made to move, each and every moment (the prakruti does but I am the purush, I do nothing).

owis.original: येक वेष धरुं नये । येक साज करुं नये । येकदेसी होऊं नये । भ्रमण करावें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकच प्रकारचा वेश नसावा. एकच प्रकारची पद्धत (फँशन) नसावी. एकाच ठिकाणीं फार वेळ न राहतां हिंडत राहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The One should not have a disguise (ie. be a body). The One should not use one instrument/apparatus (be one small body/jiva). The One should not be limited, but roam at will (maharaj be open minded).

owis.original: सलगी पडों देऊं नये । प्रतिग्रह घेऊं नये । सभेमध्यें बैसों नये । सर्वकाळ ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अतिपरिचय होऊं देऊं नये. कोणाकडून कांहीं घेऊं नये. सगळा वेळ सभेमध्यें, चार लोकांत बसूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not become intimate with anything nor take a donation (ie. `I want and need nothing'). That One should not sit in the meeting place (ie. knowledge) in this `time of the all' (be that purush and remain aloft).

owis.original: नेम आंगीं लाऊं नये । भरवसा कोणास देऊं नये । अंगीकार करुं नये । नेमस्तपणाचा ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणताही नियम लावून घेऊं नये. कोणाला आपल्या भरवश्यावर विसंबू देऊं नये. निश्र्चितपणाचा व नियमितपणाचा क्रम ठेवूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not establish any rules for the `all' body (knowledge is beyond right and wrong behaviour).1 The `all' should not be dependent. And one should not get fixed/set as this `all' body form (ie. be formless).

owis.original: नित्यनेम सांडूं नये । अभ्यास बुडों देऊं नये । परतंत्र होऊं नये । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तरी नित्यनेम सोडूं नये. आपला साधनाभ्यास बुडूं देऊं नये. वाटेल तें झालें तरी परतंत्र होऊं नये. दुसर्‍याच्या आधीन जाऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should never leave that established order, nor should one drop the practice and one should not be a dependent upon the other created `thing'.

owis.original: स्वतंत्रता मोडूं नये । निरापेक्षा तोडूं नये । परापेक्षा होऊं नये । क्षणक्ष्णा ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपली स्वतंत्रता सांभाळावी. आपली निरपेक्ष वृत्ति जोपासावी. पदोपदी दुसर्‍याकडून अपेक्षा करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not break that Self-dependence and one should be free of expectation, and each and every moment, in this `other' side (`all') there should be no desire.

owis.original: वैभव दृष्टीं पाहों नये । उपाधीसुखें राहों नये । येकांत मोडूं देऊं नये । स्वरुपस्थितीचा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वैभव, ऐश्र्वर्य डोळे भरुन पाहूं नये. उपाधीच्या सुखानें गुंतून राहूं नये. आपल्या स्वस्वरुपानुभवाचा एकान्त कधींच नाहींसा होऊं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not look at the outward glory nor should one stay in this limiting concept of happiness. Therefore the aloneness of your own swarup should not be broken.

owis.original: अनर्गळता करुं नये । लोकलाज धरुं नये । कोठेंतरी होऊं नये । आसक्त कदां ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नितिबाह्य अमर्याद वर्तन करुं नये. लोकलाज बाळगूं नये. केव्हांही उगीच कोठे तरी गुंतून पडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not behave unrestrained, nor should one care for public shame. One should not be attached to anywhere, at any time.

owis.original: परंपरा तोडूं नये । उपाधी मोडूं देऊं नये । ज्ञानमार्ग सोडूं नये । कदाकाळीं ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपणहून परंपरा तोडूं नये. उपासनेची उपाधी मोडूं देऊं नये. तरीपण ज्ञानमार्ग केव्हांही सोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should never break that continuity and nor should one allow this limiting concept `I am' to be broken. At no `time'* should the path of knowledge be left. *(The endless `now' of the `all')

owis.original: कर्ममार्ग सांडूं नये । वैराग्य मोडूं देऊं नये । साधन भजन खंडूं नये । कदाकाळीं ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कर्ममार्ग टाकूं नये. आपल्या वैराग्यास धक्का लागूं देऊं नये. आपलें साधन व भगवंताचे भजन कांहीं झालें तरी सोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: If someone tells you to wash your feet then, "Where have I got feet to wash?" At least in your mind there should be these kinds of thoughts. When you remember the Self then there is only the Self. Therefore, always have that Self conviction. 27. One should not leave the path of karma (`He is doing everything'), nor allow vairagya to be broken. One should not deny the contentment of bhajan at any `time'.

owis.original: अतिवाद करुं नये । अनित्य पोटीं धरुं नये । रागें भरीं भरों नये । भलतीकडे ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाशी फार वाद घालूं नये. अनीतिनें वागण्याची प्रवृत्ती नसावी. रागाच्या भरांत भलतीच गोष्ट करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not converse too much. One should not keep immoral intent in the mind* and one should not do anything uncontrolled, due to passions. *(See 13.10.28; keep the inner intent of just knowing)

owis.original: न मनी त्यास सांगों नये । कंटाळवाणें बोलों नये । बहुसाल असों नये । येकें स्थळीं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो आपलें ऐकत नाहीं त्यास सांगण्याच्या नादीं लागूं नये. आपलें बोलणें उगाच कंटाळवाणें नसावें. एकाच ठिकाणी पुष्कळ काळ राहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not tell these things to the one who does not value it. One should not `speak' that talk that is wearying. That One place should not be the `many' places.

owis.original: कांहीं उपाधी करुं नये । केली तरी धरुं नये । धरिली तरी सांपडों नये । उपाधीमध्यें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आधीं उपाधी निर्माण करुं नये. केली तर तिच्या मागें लागूं नये. तिच्यामागें लागलें तर तिच्यांत अडकूं नये. तिच्या आसक्तीमध्यें सांपडू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The limiting concept of the `thing' should not be made. If created then, it should not be held to. If held then, one should not be found in this limiting concept and stay aloft. (maharaj play your part well.)

owis.original: थोरपणें असों नये । महत्व धरुन बैसों नये । कांहीं मान इछूं नये । कोठेंतरी ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण कोणी मोठे आहोत अशी भावना नसावी. आपलें महत्व घट्ट धरुन बसूं नये. कोठेंही कसल्याही मानाची इच्छा मनांत नसावी.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not think of oneself as great, nor should one believe that one is impor- tant. The `thing' should not wish for honour, anywhere (to take itself as true).

owis.original: साधेपण सोडूं नये । सानेपण मोडूं नये । बळात्कारें जोडूं नये । अभिमान आंगीं ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपलें साधेपण सोडूं नये. आपलें लहानपण मोडूं नये. उगीच जबरदस्तीनें अभिमान आपल्या अंगीं लावून घेऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Simplicity should never be lost and one should not have the ego of powerfulness with regards to the body and understand its insignificance. (maharaj- the simplest of all is the Saint)

owis.original: अधिकारेवीण सांगों नये । दाटून उपदेश देऊं नये । कानकोंडा करुं नये । परमार्थ कदा ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला ज्याची योग्यता नाहीं तें त्याला सांगूं नये. कोणासहि बळजबरीनें उपदेश देऊं नये. मिंधेपणाचा परमार्थ कधीहीं करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not tell these things without the power of the Self, nor should one swell with pride while making this silent instruction (`I am He'). One should never blame paramarth nor make it cower.

owis.original: कठिण वैराग्य सोडूं नये । कठिण अभ्यास सांडूं नये । कठिणता धरुं नये कोणेकेविशइं ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वैराग्य प्रखर असावें. सपाटून अभ्यास करावा. कोणाशीहीं कठोरपणें वागूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The vairagya of the gross should not be left, nor should the *study of the gross be left. One should not conceive of grossness with regards to that One who is within everyone (purush). *(see 13.6.1)

owis.original: कठिण शब्द बोलों नये । कठिण आज्ञा करुं नये । कठिण धीरत्व सोडूं नये । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणालाही कठोर शब्द बोलूं नये. कोणाला पाळण्यास कठीण अशी आज्ञा करुं नये. वाटेल तें झालें तरी आपलें धैर्य मजबूत घट्ट ठेवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The gross words should not be `spoken'. The gross commands should not be made and one should not conceive of grossness for this created `thing'.

owis.original: आपण आसक्त होऊं नये । केल्यावीण सांगों नये । बहुसाल मागों नये । शिष्यवर्गांसी ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण कशांतही मनानें गुंतूं नये. आपण स्वतः केल्यावाचून दुसर्‍यास  सांगूं नये. शिष्याजवळ सहसा कांहीं मागूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not be attached to oneself. Without the created thing, one should not make thoughtlessness. And one should not beg for the `many' things from your disciple (ie. the mind is the disciple/shishya).

owis.original: उत्धट शब्द बोलों नये । इंद्रियेंस्मरण करुं नये । शाक्तमार्गे भरों नये । मुक्तपणें भरी ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उद्धट शब्द बोलूं नये. इंद्रियें व इंद्रियसुख यांचें स्मरण करुं नये. शाक्तमार्गानें जाऊन स्वच्छंदपणें वागण्याच्या भरीला पडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not `speak' the arrogant `word' nor remember the organs of sense and action. One should not swell and be satisfied with this power/shakti, but should be filled with liberation.

owis.original: नीच कृतीं लाजों नये । वैभव होतां माजों नये । क्रोधें भरीं भरों नये । जाणपणें ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हलकें काम करावयास लाजूं नये. वैभव मिळालें असतां उन्मत्त होऊं नये. समजून उमजून रागाच्या भरीला पडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The continuous and eternal should not be ashamed to do work and should not swell up when glory (`I am') comes. One should not be filled with anger that comes from knowingness (`I know - what do they know?')

owis.original: थोरपणें चुकों नये । न्याये नीति सांडूं नये । अप्रमाण वर्तो नये । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठेपणामुळें गैरवर्तन करुं नये. नीतिन्यायाची मर्यादा सोडूं नये. वाटेल तें झालें तरी स्वैराचारानें वागूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not forget that greatness. One should not disregard true justice and correctness. One should not act without power and create this `thing'.

owis.original: कळल्यावीण बोलों नये । अनुमानें निश्र्चय करुं नये । सांगतां दुःख धरुं नये । मूर्खपणें ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें कळलें नाहीं तें सांगूं नये. केवळ कल्पनेनें अमुक अमुक आहे असें निश्र्चितपणें सांगूं नये. कोणी कांहीं उत्तम गोष्ट सांगितली तर ती शिकावी, आपल्या अज्ञानाचें दुःख न मानावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not `speak' without understanding. One should not have faith in that which is merely conjecture and one should make Oneself thoughtless and not hold the painful, on account of foolishness.

owis.original: सावधपण सोडूं नये । व्यापकपण सांडूं नये । कदा सुख मानूं नये । निसुगपणाचें ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व बाबतींत दक्षता असावी. मनाचा मोठेपणा असावा. कधीहीं आळशीपणांत सुख वाटूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not fail to be alert and should not leave your pervasiveness. One should never get happiness out of being lazy and inattentive.

owis.original: विकल्प पोटीं धरुं नये । स्वार्थआज्ञा करुं नये । केली तरी टाकूं नये । आपणास पुढें ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनांत संशय धरुं नये. आपला स्वार्थ साधण्यासाठीं कोणास कांहीं आज्ञा करुं नये. तशी आज्ञा करण्याची वेळ आलीच तर तिच्यामध्यें फक्त आपल्याच पुरता फायदा नसावा. सगळ्यांचा असावा.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not keep wrong thoughts/vikalpa in mind (ie. opposite of sankalpa; `I am He'). One should not make this selfish command (`I want to be and simply know'). But if made then you should not abandon it later.

owis.original: प्रसंगेवीण बोलों नये । अन्वयेंवीण गाऊं नये । विचारेंवीण जाऊं नये । अविचारपंथे ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रसंग पाहून बोलावें. योग्य असेल तर गावें. विचाराचा त्याग करुन अविचाराच्या मार्गानें जाऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not `speak' without this `I am' connection and without this connection one should not `sing'. One should not go without thoughtlessness on the path devoid of that Self.

owis.original: परोपकार सांडूं नये । परपीडा करुं नये । विकल्प पडों देऊं नये । कोणीयेकासी ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परोपकार करण्याचे सोडूं नये. दुसर्‍याला कधीं पीडा देऊं नये. दुसर्‍या कोणास आपल्याविषयीं विकल्प येऊं देवूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not leave That which uplifts the `other'. One should not harm the `other' and one should not embark upon a doubt but give it to the One who is within everyone. (The other is this `all', but in truth, there is `no-otherness')

owis.original: नेणपण सोडूं नये । महंतपण सांडूं नये । द्रव्यासाठीं हिंडो नये । कीर्तन करीत ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्याला सर्व ज्ञान नाहीं ही भावना सोडूं नये. महंतपण सोडूं नये. पैसा मिळवण्यासाठीं कीर्तन करीत हिंडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not leave `not knowingness' and one should not imagine that one is a mahanta/spiritual teacher. One should not wander and make kirtana for the wealth of the `many'.

owis.original: संशयात्मक बोलों नये । बहुत निश्र्चये करुं नये । निर्वाहेंवीण धरुं नये । ग्रंथ हातीं ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ऐकणार्‍याच्या मनांत संशय निर्माण होईल असें बोलूं नये. अनेक प्रकारचे निश्र्चय करुं नयेत. जेवढे निश्र्चय पाळणें शक्य आहे तेवढेंच करावेत. ग्रंथाचा उत्तम अभ्यास असल्याखेरीज तो लोकांना सांगण्यास हाती घेऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not `speak' with doubt nor should the `all' make any resolve (it already is a resolve). One should not hold this scripture in the hand without seeing it through to the end (know the innermost meaning; it is not just another book).

owis.original: जाणपणें पुसों नये । अहंभाव दिसों नये । सांगेन ऐसें म्हणों नये । कोणीयेकासी ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण सर्व जाणतो ही भावना धरुन कोणास प्रश्र्न विचारुं नये. आपल्या अहंकाराचे प्रदर्शन करुं नये. " मी सांगतों, त्यांत काय आहे " असे कोणास म्हणूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this knowingness, one should never be wiped away. This feeling `I am' should not promise or give reason for hope. And one should not say, "I will tell you" (I know better than you) to that One within everyone (purush).

owis.original: ज्ञानगर्व धरुं नये । सहसा छळणा करुं नये । कोठें वाद घालूं नये । कोणीयेकासी ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या ज्ञानाचा गर्व नसावा. सहसा कोणाचा बुद्धिभेद करुं नये. कोणाशीहिं कोठेहिं वाद घालूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not have the pride of knowledge, nor on any account harass or argue anywhere with that One within everyone.

owis.original: स्वार्थबुद्धी जडों नये । कारबारी पडों नये । कार्येकर्ते होऊं नये । राजद्वारीं ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या अंगीं स्वार्थबुद्धि जडूं देऊं नये. कारभाराच्या कामांत पडूं नये. राजाच्या पदरीं काम स्वीकारु नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not meet that selfish buddhi nor should one be involved in its business and one should not be constantly active, using the King's (purush) `name' (`I am').

owis.original: कोणास भर्वसा देऊं नये । जड भिक्षा मागों नये । भिक्षेसाठीं सांगों नये । परंपरा आपुली ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाला उगीच आश्र्वासनें देऊं नयेत. जड भिक्षा मागूं नये. भिक्षा घालावी म्हणून आपली गुरुपरंपरा व उपासना परंपरा सांगूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not give regard to this `all' and one should not beg for *gross alms/bhiksha. For bhiksha one should not break your understanding. *(maharaj-begging is an art. One should beg with no desire in mind)

owis.original: सोइरिकींत पडों नये । मध्यावर्ति घडों नये । प्रपंचाची जडों नये । उपाधी आंगीं ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाची सोयरीक जमवण्यांत पडूं नये. कोठें मध्यस्थी करुं नये. प्रपंचाची उपाधी आपल्यामागे लागूं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not get involved with marriages nor mediate in disputes. One should not meet the limiting concept of prapanch that is within this `all' body.

owis.original: प्रपंचप्रस्तीं जाऊं नये । बाष्कळ अन्न खाऊं नये । पाहुण्यासरिसें घेऊं नये । आमंत्रणें कदां ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेथें प्रपंचाचे प्रस्थ असेल तेथें आपण जाऊं नये. अपवित्र अन्न खाऊं नये. पाहुण्यांबरोबर आमंत्रणें घेऊं नयेत.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not enter into this prapanch and one should eat this `food' without restraint. One should not accept an invitation as a guest.

owis.original: श्राध पक्ष सटी सामासें । शांती फळशोबन बारसें । भोग राहाण बहुवसें । नवस व्रतें उद्यापनें ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्राद्ध, पक्ष, सटी, सहामास, शांति, फलशोभन, बारसें, नवस, भुताटकी, व्रतें, उद्यापनें वगैरे,
owis.englishMeaning: There are the programmes to commemorate the dead, the many ceremonies with regards to pregnancy or the naming of a child; there are the rites in connection with spiritual gatherings and fastings.

owis.original: तेथें निस्पृहें जाऊं नये । त्यांचें अन्न खाऊं नये । येळिलवाणें करुं नये । आपणासी ॥ ५४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रसंगासाठीं निस्पृहानें जाऊं नये. ते थील अन्न खाऊं नये. तें अन्न खाल्ल्यानें ओशाळेपण येतें, तें येऊं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: But the desireless `there' should not come `here' and this `food' of that paramatma should not be devoured (that atma is the one who eats, the eating and that which is eaten). One should not bow in supplication to yourself (`I am').

owis.original: लग्नमुहूर्तीं जाऊं नये । पोटासाठीं गाऊं नये । मोलें कीर्तन करुं नये । कोठेंतरी ॥ ५५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लग्नमुहुर्ताच्या प्रसंगीं जाऊं नये. पोटासाठीं गाणें गाऊं नये. कोठेही पैसे घेऊन किर्तन करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not go to wedding programmes (or be industriously engaged in activity) nor sing for the belly. One should never, anywhere, make kirtana for payment (no desire).

owis.original: आपली भिक्षा सोडूं नये । वारें अन्न खाऊं नये । निस्पृहासि घडों नये । मोलयात्रा ॥ ५६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपलें भिक्षेचे व्रत सोडूं नये. वार लावून जेवूं नये. निस्पृहानें दुसर्‍याच्या पैशानें यात्रा करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not throw away your own bhiksha (see following chapter; only the purush eats bhiksha). One should not eat the empty food of the senses. And the desireless should not make the `pilgrimage of money'.

owis.original: मोठें सुकृत करुं नये । मोलपुजारी होऊं नये । दिल्हा तरी घेऊं नये । इनाम निस्पृहें ॥ ५७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पैसे घेऊन पुण्यकर्म करुं नये. राजानेम किंवा इतर कोणी इनाम देऊं केलें तर निस्पृहानें तें घेऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not do this worthy `action' for payment/reward (with desire in mind). One should not do puja for reward (for the fruit of action) and even if the reward is given, still the desireless should not take it (remain aloft, `I need nothing').

owis.original: कोठें मठ करुं नये । केला तरी तो धरुं नये । मठपती होऊन बैसों नये । निस्पृह पुरुषें ॥ ५८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोठेहीं मठ बांधूं नये. बांधल्यास त्याला धरुन राहूं नये. निस्पृह पुरुषानें मठपती बनून राहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not make a math anywhere (religious centre, the `all'), and if made still, that atma should not hold it. The desireless purush should not take up the position of its leader.

owis.original: निस्पृहें अवघेंचि करावें । परी आपण तेथें न संपडावें । परस्परें उभारावें । भक्तिमार्गासी ॥ ५९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निस्पृहानें सारें कांहीं करावें पण मीपणानें आपण त्यामध्यें न सापडावे. लोकांकडून परस्पर भक्तिमार्ग वाढीस लावावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Desirelessness should be created by the wandering mind, but you should not be found `there'. The path of devotion (no-otherness) should be effortlessly established by mutual understanding (when I am not, then He is there).

owis.original: प्रेत्नेविण राहों नये । आळस दृष्टी आणूं नये । देह अस्तां पाहों नये । वियोग उपासनेचा ॥ ६० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यानें प्रयत्न केल्यावांचून राहूं नये. आळसाला समोरसुद्धा येऊं देवूं नये. जोपर्यंत देह आहे तोपर्यंत उपासनेमधें खंड पडूं देवूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not stay anywhere without making this great effort; and through la- ziness (ie. forgetting swarup) one should not bring the visible (ie. `I am everything, everywhere'). Though the body is there, one should not see it and in this way never be separated from your worship.

owis.original: उपाधीमध्यें पडो नये । उपाधी आंगीं जडों नये । भजनमार्ग मोडूं नये । निसंगळपणें ॥ ६१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण उपाधीमध्यें पडूं नये. आपल्या अंगीं उपाधी चिकटू देऊं नये. भगवंताची उपासना व भजन नाकर्तेपणानें मोडूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not descend into the limiting concepts created by "I am a body", nor should one meet with the limiting concept of this `all' body. By detachment one should not break the path of bhajan.

owis.original: बहु उपाधी करुं नये । उपाधीविण कामा नये । सगुणभक्ति सोडूं नये । विभक्ति खोटी ॥ ६२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निस्पृहानें फार उपाधी करुं नये. पण अगदी मुळींच उपाधीवाचून राहूं नये. त्यानें सगुणाची भक्ति सोडूं नये. पण देवाहून वेगळेंपणें राहणेही बरें नाहीं. सगुणाच्या भक्तिमध्यें देव आणि भक्त वेगळे असतात. पण अंतर्यामी भक्तानेम देवाशी तदाकार असावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not make the limiting concept of the `many' and without this limiting concept (`I am not the body, I am He') there should be no action. One should not leave this devotion to the sagun, but to be separate from God is not correct (see 4.9.4).

owis.original: बहुसाल धांवों नये । बहुसाल राहों नये । बहुत कष्ट करुं नये । असुदें खोटें ॥ ६३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार धावाधाव नसावी. तसेंच फार एके ठिकाणी राहाणें नसावें. फार कष्ट करुं नयेत. तसेंच उगीच आळशी नसावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not run fruitlessly after the `many', and one should not stay in the `many'. One should not give trouble to the `all', though this freedom of the `all' is false.

owis.original: बहुसाल बोलों नये । अबोलणें कामा नये । बहुत अन्न खाऊं नये । उपवास खोटा ॥ ६४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार बोलणें नसावें. तसेंच अगदी अबोल पण नसावें. फार अन्न खाऊं नये. तसेंच उपवास करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not `speak' to the `many'. No action is to be made without this `speech'. The divine `food' should not be consumed but fasting is of no use.

owis.original: बहुसाल निजों नये । बहुत निद्रा मोडूं नये । बहु नेम धरुं नये । बाष्कळ खोटें ॥ ६५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार झोप घेऊं नये. तसेंच फार झोप मोडूं नये. फार नेम धरुं नयेत. तसेंच नियमविरहीत असूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not sleep the sleep of the `many' and should not break the sleep of the `all' (and sleep to this world). One should not make the vows of the `many' and to be unrestrained is also wrong.

owis.original: बहु जनीं असों नये । बहु आरण्य सेऊं नये । बहु देह पाळूं नये । आत्महत्या खोटी ॥ ६६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार वेळ लोकांत असूं नये. तसेंच सारखें अरण्यवासी होऊं नये. देहाला फार सांभाळूं नये. तसेंच त्याला मारुन टाकणेंही बरें नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not be in the world of the `many' and one should not live in this lonely place of the `many' ("I am just one body in this world"). One should not pamper the body of the `many', for killing that atma is wrong.

owis.original: बहु संग धरुं नये । संतसंग सांडूं नये । कर्मठपण कामा न ये । अनाचार खोटा ॥ ६७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उगीच पुष्कळ लोकांची संगत धरुं नये. संतसज्जनांची संगत सोडूं नये. आचारामध्यें कर्मठपणा नसावा. तसेंच आचार विचारहीनही नसावा.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not be attached to the `many' and one should not leave the company of the Truth (ie. satsang). Rites and rituals are of no use for these impure actions are fraudulent.

owis.original: बहु लोकिक सांडूं नये । लोकाधेन होऊं नये । बहु प्रीती काना नये । निष्ठुरता खोटी ॥ ६८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार लोकाचार सोडूं नये. पण अगदी लोकांच्या आधीन होऊं नये. कोणावरही फार प्रेम करुं नये. पण प्रेमहीनपणानेही वागूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The worldly `many' is of no use and therefore one should not rely on this world. The love for the `many' is of no use but that does not mean one should not be heartless.

owis.original: बहु संशये धरुं नये । मुक्तमार्ग कामा नये । बहु साधनीं पडों नये । साधनेंवीण खोटें ॥ ६९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार संशयी असूं नये. तसेंच अगदी बंधनरहितपणाही करुं नये. फार साधना करण्याच्या मागें लागूं नये. तसेंच साधनेवांचून राहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' should not even hold this `all' for it is also a doubt and this path of liberation (ie. `all') is not required in the end. One should not be in the sadhanas of the `many', but one should not be without sadhana (`I am He').

owis.original: बहु विषये भोगूं नये । विषयत्याग करितां नये । देहलोभ धरुं नये । बहु त्रास खोटा ॥ ७० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: फार इंद्रियसुख भोगूं नये. तसेंच इंद्रियसुख अगदी सोडूनही देऊं नये. देहाचा लोभ धरुं नये. पण देहाला फार त्रासही देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not enjoy the sense objects of the `many' but one should not give up the sense object.2 One should not have any affection for the body, for even its `many' troubles are not real.

owis.original: वेगळा अनुभव घेऊं नये । अनुभवेंवीण कामा नये । आत्मस्थिती बोलों नये । स्तब्धता खोटी ॥ ७१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येक गोष्टीचा स्वतः वेगळा अनुभव घेण्याच्या मागें जाऊं नये. पण कांहीं गोष्टींचा अनुभव घेतल्याखेरीज राहूं नये. आपली अंतर्यामीची स्वरुपानुभूती उघडपणें बोलूं नये. पण तीच्याविषयीं अगदी मौन धरणेंही योग्य नव्हे.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not accept the `experience' of being separate (sagun), yet without this `experience' is of no use. That atma should not `speak' for this silence is also false. (maharaj- silence is also not true)

owis.original: मन उरों देऊं नये । मनेंवीण कामा नये । अलक्ष वस्तु लक्षा नये । लक्षेंवीण खोटें ॥ ७२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मन मारुन नाहींसे कराबें. मनाला शिल्लक उरुं देऊं नये. पण मनावांचून असतां कामा नये. सद्वस्तू ध्यानाच्या कक्षेंत येत नाहीं हें खरें पण ध्यानावांचून राहणें खरें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not remain as a mind, yet without the mind is of no use (maharaj- when you understand yourself, let all thoughts come for you know, I am not the thoughts). One should not concentrate on that Self, for it cannot be concentrated on. Yet it is wrong to be without concentration (until you transcend the mind, one should concentrate on this `all' by forgetting the `many' names and forms). 2 maharaj renounce the renouncing, why to renounce that which is not true.

owis.original: मनबुद्धीअगोचर । बुद्धीवीण अंधकार । जाणीवेचा पडो विसर । नेणीव खोटी ॥ ७३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मवस्तु मनाला आणि बुद्धीला आकलन होत नाहीं. मन व बुद्धी तिच्यापर्यंत पोचूं शकत नाहीत. पण बुद्धीनें विवेक केला नाहीं तर आंत बाहेर अज्ञानाचा अंधार राहतो. मीपणाच्या जाणीवेचा संपूर्ण विसर पडला पाहिजे. परंतु नुसती नेणीव बाळगणें खरें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: It is beyond the perception of mind and buddhi, but without the buddhi there is darkness. The remembering of knowing should be dropped, but ignorance is false (no need to remember anything; then He is there).

owis.original: ज्ञातेपणा धरुं नये । ज्ञानेंवीण कामा नये । अतर्क्य वस्तु तर्का न ये । तर्केंवीण खोटें ॥ ७४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: " मी ज्ञाता आहे " असा ज्ञातेपणा अंगीं धरुं नये. पण ज्ञानावाचून असतां कामा नये. ब्रह्मवस्तु तर्काच्या पलीकडे असल्यानें तर्काच्या आवाक्यांत ती येत नाहीं. परंतु तर्काचा उपयोग केल्यावांचून राहाणें खरें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not hold on to knower-ness, yet without knowledge is of no use. One should not use logic on that Self that is beyond logic; yet to be without logic is wrong (maharaj- forget everything and you become a fountain of right thoughts).

owis.original: दृश्यस्मरण कामा नये । विस्मरण पडों नये । कांहीं चर्चा करुं नये । केलीयावीण न चले ॥ ७५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताच्या स्मरणा आड येते म्हणून दृश्याचें स्मरण करतां कामा नये. पण दृशाचे संपूर्ण विस्मरण होऊं नये. तसें झालें तर माणसाचा सर्व व्यवहार विस्कटेल. वायफळ चर्चा करुं नये. पण प्रसंगानुसार चर्चा केल्यावांचून चालत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Remembering the visible should not be done (ie. just forget everything and He is naturally there), but one should not descend into forgetting. The gossip of this `thing' should not be made, but one should not set out without that created `thing'

owis.original: जगीं भेद कामा नये । वर्णसंकर करुं नये । आपला धर्म उडऊं नये । अभिमान खोटा ॥ ७६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें भेद असतां कामा नये. पण भेद नको म्हणून वर्णसंकर करुं नये. आपण आपला धर्म सोडूं नये. पण धर्माचा दुराभिमान खरा नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: In the world, separation is of no use and one should not create confusion by mixing the castes (four castes are the four bodies and you are the brahmin only). You should not leave your own dharma, but the ego of it is wrong (see 8.9.54)

owis.original: आशाबद्धता बोलों नये । विवेकेंवीण चालों नये । समाधान हालों नये । कांहीं केल्यां ॥ ७७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनामध्यें स्वार्थीपणा किंवा कशाची अपेक्षा ठेवून बोलूं नये. विवेक केल्याखेरीज वर्तन करुं नये. काय वाटेल तें झालें तरी आपलें समाधान भंगूं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The prison of hope should not be `spoken'. Without vivek one should not go any- where. And that complete contentment should not be disturbed by this created `thing'.

owis.original: अबद्ध पोथी लेहो नये । पोथीवीण कामा नये । अबद्ध वाचूं नये । वाचिल्यावीण खोटें ॥ ७८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अव्यवस्थितपणें ग्रंथ लिहूं नये. पण ग्रंथ लिहून घेतल्यावांचून राहूम नये. अव्यवस्थितपणेम ग्रंथ वाचूं नये. पण ग्रंथ वांचल्यावाचून राहूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: A careless, irrelevant book (of the `many') should not be written.* But to be without this well written book is of no use. Careless, irrelevant reading should not be made, but to be without this `reading' (ie. witnessing) is not correct. *(This sagun `story' is in the well written book and it is written from just a point of knowledge; see 14.5- to make the `story' of hari is to write properly)

owis.original: निस्पृहें वगत्रुत्व सांडूं नये । आशंका घेतां भांडों नये । श्रोतयांचा मानूं नये । वीट कदा ॥ ७९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निस्पृह पुरुषानें निरुपण, प्रवचन करणें सोडूं नये. श्रोत्यांपैकी कोणी आक्षेप घेतल्यास त्यांच्याबरोबर भांडू नये. त्यांनी शंका घेणें हें अज्ञानाचे लक्षण आहे. श्रोत्यांचा कधी कंटाळा करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The desireless should not leave this pure `speech' and should not quarrel with this doubt of the `all' (the `all' is an appearance therefore it is not doubtless). The regard of that good listener should never tire.

owis.original: हे सिकवण धरितां चित्तीं । सकळ सुखें वोळगती । आंगीं बाणे महंती । अकस्मात ॥ ८० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो कोणी ही शिकवण मनांत धारण करतो त्याला सगळी सुखें वश होतील. आणि त्याच्या अंगी एकदम महंतपणा बाणेल.
owis.englishMeaning: If that thoughtless Self holds these teaching firmly in His chitta, then the joy of this `all' will come `there' for protection and immediately thoughtlessness will be accepted throughout this `all' body. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: ब्राह्मणाची मुख्य दीक्षा । मागितली पाहिजे भिक्षा । वों भवति या पक्षा । रक्षिलें पाहिजे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्राह्मणाच्या जीवन आचारामध्यें " भिक्षा मागणें " हें प्रमुख लक्षण आहे. ॐ भवति भिक्षां देहि या ब्रीदाचे रक्षण केलें पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: The principle duty of a brahmin is to request bhiksha/alms. "aum, give some alms." This `speech' should be carefully guarded when requesting bhiksha/alms (`I am He' and for the body there is begging).

owis.original: भिक्षा मागोन जो जेविला । तो निराहारी बोलिला । प्रतिग्रहावेगळा जाला । भिक्षा मागतां ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो साधक भिक्षा मागून जेवतो, तो निराहारी म्हणून ओळखला जातो. त्यानें भिक्षा मागून पोट भरल्यानें कोणाकडून फुकट दान घेतल्याचा दोष त्यास लागत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If it is that purush who eats this requested bhiksha then, there will be this `speech' and then He is observing a fast (ie. He is the Knower and He is the food and the eating also). Asking for bhiksha is altogether different from receiving a gift (maharaj- have no desire in mind).

owis.original: संतासंत जे जन । तेथें कोरान्न मागोन करी भोजन । तेणें केलें अमृतप्राशन । प्रतिदिनीं ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सज्जन आणि दुर्जन दोन्ही तर्‍हेचे लोक जेथें राहतात अशा वस्तीमध्यें कोरडी भिक्षा मागून जो पोट भरतो, तो रोज अमृताचे सेवन करतो, असें म्हणावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there has been this vivek between the eternal and non-eternal then, it is brahman who is requesting this simplest of `food' and it is brahman who enjoys that. Due to this, there is the daily `drinking of immortal nectar' (ie. as long as `I am' is there, you cannot die).

owis.original: ऐसा भिक्षेचा महिमा । भिक्षा माने सर्वोत्तमा । ईश्र्वराचा अगाध महिमा । तोहि भिक्षा मागे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षा मागण्याचा महिमा असा आहे. भगवंताला भिक्षा पसंत आहे. श्रीशंकराचा थोरपणा केवढा मोठा आहे, पण तो देखील भिक्षा मागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is the greatness of bhiksha. Only that purush enjoys this bhiksha. The greatness of ishwara/shiva is truly unfathomable, but even He requests for bhiksha only (He enjoys whatever comes, without any desire in mind).

owis.original: दत्त गोरक्ष आदिकरुनी । सिद्ध भिक्षा मागती जनीं । निस्पृहता भिक्षेपासुनी । प्रगट होये ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दत्त, गोरखनाथ इत्यादि सिद्धसुद्धां लोकांमध्यें भिक्षा मागतात. भिक्षा मागण्यामध्यें निस्पृहता प्रगट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: datta, goraksha and others like them asked for bhiksha and the siddha/accomplished within this world asks for bhiksha. Due to bhiksha, desirelessness manifests (let whatever comes be sufficient; I am requesting for this body only).

owis.original: वार लाऊन बैसला । तरी तो पराधेन जाला । तैसीच नित्यावळीला । स्वतंत्रता कैंची ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो माणूस वार लावून जेवतो किंवा पोट भरतो, तो पराधीन बनतो. त्याचप्रमाणें जो एखाद्या माणसाच्या घरी रोज जेवतो, त्याचे स्वातंत्र्य नष्ट होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When one fixes a day to sit and eat somewhere then that atma becomes dependent. If this is done every day then, how can there be the independence of that atma?

owis.original: आठां दिवसां धान्य मेळविलें । तरी तें कंटाळवाणें जालें । प्राणी येकायेकीं चेवलें । नित्यनूतनतेपासुनी ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रोजची भिक्षा न करतां आठ दिवसांची भिक्षा मागण्याची पद्धत ठेवणे योग्य नाहीं. तें कंटाळवाणें होते. रोज भिक्षा मागल्यानें जी नित्यनूतनता, रोजचा नवीनपणा असतो तो चटदिशीं नाहींसा होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If a week's supply of grain is collected, then that which is `ever new' becomes choosy ("I want this and not that" etc.) and then in the prana, that brahman becomes a foolish jiva.

owis.original: नित्य नूतन हिंडावें । उदंड देशाटण करावें । तरीच भिक्षा मागतां बरवें । श्र्लाघ्यवाणें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रोज नव्या नव्या ठिकाणी भिक्षेसाठीं हिंडावें, सपाटून प्रवास पर्यटन करावें. असें केलें तर भिक्षा मागण्याचें खरें कौतुकआहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That eternal and ever new should wander. That vast paramatma should travel all around and then only is the asking of bhiksha proper and praiseworthy.

owis.original: अखंड भिक्षेचा अभ्यास । तयास वाटेना परदेश । जिकडे तिकडे स्वदेश । भुवनत्रैं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सदैव भिक्षा मागून पोट भरण्याची ज्याला सवय आहे, त्याला कोणताही प्रांत परदेश असा वाटत नाहीं. जिकडेतिकडे भुवनत्रयामध्यें स्वदेशच आहे, असे त्यास वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: When that unbroken paramatma makes this practice of bhiksha then, that does not feel that this is a foreign place (maharaj everyone is a foreigner. They are away from the atma). Then, `Everywhere in the three worlds is my own place.' (maharaj when I went on the tour of `the world is Myself'...)

owis.original: भिक्षा मागतां किरकों नये । भिक्षा मागतां लाजों नये । भिक्षा मागतां भागों नये । परिभ्रमण करावें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षा मागण्यास कुरकुरु नये. भिक्षा मागतांना लाजूं नये. भिक्षा मागतांना थकून जाऊं नये. भिक्षेच्या निमित्यानें सारखें फिरत राहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not complain while asking *bhiksha. One should not feel shame while asking bhiksha. One should not feel divided and so wander freely while asking bhiksha. *(To accept whatever comes without attraction or repulsion)

owis.original: भिक्षा आणि चमत्कार । च्चाकाटती लहानथोर । कीर्ति वर्णी निरंतर । भगवंताची ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा माणूस भिक्षा मागतो पण चमत्कार करतो. असें ऐकल्यावर लहान मोठी माणसें आश्र्चर्यचकित होतात. तसेंच तो भगवंताची कीर्ति निरंतर गातो, हें पाहून सर्वांना कौतुक वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: bhiksha brings this miracle of `I am' and that small jiva within that great brahman is struck with wonder and amazement. Then there is always the proclaiming of the pervasiveness of God.

owis.original: भिक्षा म्हणिजे कामधेनु । सदा फळ नव्हे सामान्यु । भिक्षेस करी जो अमान्यु । तो करंटा जोगी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षा म्हणजे कामधेनूच होय. ती सदैव हवें तें फळ देणारी असल्यानें कांहीं सामान्य नव्हे. भिक्षा ज्याला मान्य नाही असा यति किंवा बैरागी भाग्यहीन समजावा.
owis.englishMeaning: bhiksha means the wish-fulfilling cow; it is the eternal fruit and it is not ordinary. But if that purush makes bhiksha faithlessly, then he is just a miserable renunciate.

owis.original: भिक्षेनें वोळखी होती । भिक्षेनें भरम चुकती । सामान्य भिक्षा मान्य करिती । सकळ प्राणी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षेमुळें नव्या ओळखी होतात. भिक्षेनें चुकीच्या कल्पना नाहींश्या होतात. भिक्षा वाटते मामुली पण सर्वांना ती मान्य आहे यांत शंका नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to bhiksha this `all' appears. Due to bhiksha delusion is forgotten. When that one within the prana makes bhiksha then, this `all' is being honoured.

owis.original: भिक्षा म्हणिजे निर्भये स्थिती । भिक्षेनें प्रगटे महंती । स्वतंत्रता ईश्र्वरप्राप्ती । भिक्षागुणें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षा मागणारा माणूस निर्भय स्थितींत असतो. भिक्षा मागण्यानें महंतपणा प्रगट होतो. स्वातंत्र्य व भगवंताची प्राप्ति हे दोन गुण भिक्षा मागणारास प्राप्त होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: bhiksha is the state of fearlessness (ie. let whatever come, I don't care). Due to bhiksha, independence manifests in that purush and due to this pure sattwa guna of bhiksha, ishwara (ie. the Witness) is attained.

owis.original: भिक्षेस नाहीं आडथाळा । भिक्षाहारी तो मोकळा । भिक्षेकरितां सार्थक वेळा । काळ जातो ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षेला कधीं कसला आडथळा येत नाहीं. भिक्षेवर पोट भरणारा सदैव मोकळा असतो. भिक्षेच्या योगानें सगळा काळ सार्थकीं लावतां येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There are no bindings in bhiksha and the one who eats of bhiksha is open and free. Due to bhiksha the period of the `many' acquires its meaning and goes to the `time of the all' (the mind becomes `I am'/knowledge)

owis.original: भिक्षा म्हणिजे अमरवल्ली । जिकडे तिकडे लगडली । अवकाळीं फळदायेनी जाली । निर्ल्लजासी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षा म्हणजे अमृतवल्ली आहे. जिकडेतिकडे ती फळाफुलांनी बहरलेलीं असतें. एखाद्यावर जेव्हां अवदशा गुदरते, त्यावेळीं लाज सोडून भिक्षा मागणार्‍यास ती मोठी फलदायिनी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: bhiksha is an immortal vine and here, there, everywhere it bares fruits. To the one who is shameless, it is the giver of this fruit of `I am' in this difficult time (of "I am a body").

owis.original: पृथ्वीमधें देश नाना । फिरतां उपवासी मरेना । कोणे येके ठाईं जना । जड नव्हे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीवर अनेक देश आहेत. त्या देशांमधून पर्यटन करतांना उपाशी मरण्याची पाळी येत नाहीं. भिक्षा मागणारा माणूस कोठल्याहि ठिकाणीं लोकांना जड होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the great earth element there are `many' countries but by wandering on this fast one does not die (ie. the `many' brings death but this `I am' brings immortality). For when there is that place of the purush, there cannot be the inanimate and objective places of the people.

owis.original: गोरज्या वाणिज्य कृषी । त्याहून प्रतिष्ठा भिक्षेसी । विसंभों नये झोळीसी । कदाकाळीं ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गुरें पाळणें, व्यापार करणें आणि शेती करणें या व्यवसायांहून भिक्षेची प्रतिष्ठा, सामजिक स्थान अधिक आहे. म्हणून महंतानें आपली झोळी कधीं बाजूला करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the tending of cows, commercial business and agriculture, but requesting for bhiksha is respected more than these. Therefore do not stop for a moment and stay in these begging professions (never take yourself as someone and beg for happiness, for happiness is your very nature).

owis.original: भिक्षेऐसें नाहीं वैराग्य । वैराग्यापरतें नाहीं भाग्य । वैराग्य नस्तां अभाग्य । येकदेसी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षेसारखें वैराग्य नाहीं आणि वैराग्यासारखें भाग्य नाहीं. ज्या माणसापासहीं वैराग्य नाहीं, तो माणूस आकुंचित व अभागी समजावा.
owis.englishMeaning: There is no vairagya like bhiskha and there is nothing more fortunate than vairagya. Where there is no vairagya, there is the misfortune of being limited to one place.

owis.original: कांहीं भिक्षा आहे म्हणावें । अल्पसंतोषी असावें । बहुत आणितां घ्यावें । मुष्टी येक ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाच्या दारापुढें उभे राहून " कांहीं भिक्षा मिळेल कां? " असें मोठ्यानें म्हणावें. पुष्कळ भिक्षा घालायला आणली तर मूठभर घ्यावी. भिक्षा मागणारानें अल्पसंतोषीं असावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This `thing' should be called your bhiksha; one should be in the contentment of this `I am'. And after when this `I am' has been brought then, that very subtle brahman should be accepted.

owis.original: सुखरुप भिक्षा मागणें । ऐसीं निस्पृहतेचीं लक्षणें । मृद वागविळास करणें । परम सौख्यकारी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठ्या प्रसन्नतेनें भिक्षा मागावी. निस्पृहतेची लक्षणें अशी आहेत. दुसर्‍याशी बोलतांना गोड मृदु शब्द बोलावेत. ऐकणारास आनंद वाटेल असा वाग्विलास असावा.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the happiness of `I am' when one asks for bhiksha and such is the attention of the desireless. By making this soft `speech', that Supreme is the giver of happiness.

owis.original: ऐसी भिक्षेची स्थिती । अल्प बोलिलें येथामती । भिक्षा वांचवी विपत्ती । होणार काळीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिक्षेची स्थिती ही अशी असते. ती मी येथें यथामति सांगितली. पुढें येणार्‍या आपत्कालापासून भिक्षा माणसास वाचवते.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is this state of bhiksha. It is this soft `speech' of an understanding mind. bhiksha keeps one untouched/safe in the time of misfortune (having become a gross body) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Kavitva Kala Nirupan (A Discourse on the Art of Poetry)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: कवित्व शब्दसुमनमाळा । अर्थ परिमळ आगळा । तेणें संतषट्पदकुळा । आनंद होये ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्दरुपी फुलांची माळा म्हणजेच काव्य. कवितेचा अर्थ म्हणजे त्या माळेंतील सुंदर फुलांचा सुगंध होय.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem is a garland made of this pure `word'. Its meaning has a very special fragrance and just like the bees around the flowers, it gives bliss to the Saints. (Its meaning remains when the gross objects have gone, just like the fragrance of the flowers remain even if the flowers are removed)

owis.original: ऐसी माळा अंतःकरणीं । गुंफून पूजा रामचरणीं । वोंकारतंत अखंडपणीं । खंडूं च नये ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा शब्दरुपी फुलांची माळा अंतःकरणी गुंफावीआणि पूजा म्हणून रामचरणीं वाहावी. सर्व शब्दांचे मूळरुप म्हणजे ओंकार होय. परेपासून ( परा वाणी ) वैखरीपर्यंत त्याचा तंतु अखंड राहतो. तो तंतु तुटणार नाहीं याची काळजी घ्यावी.
owis.englishMeaning: When such a garland is strung together in your *antah-karana then, one is worship- ping lord ram's/Master's feet. Therefore this continuous connection with this original `word' should not be broken. *(This knowing faculty consists of knowing, the mind, intellect, thinking and ego. It is the workings of this thing we refer to as our brain)

owis.original: परोपकाराकाीरणें । कवित्व अगत्य करणें । तया कवित्वाचीं लक्षणें । बोलिजेती ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जनतेचे कल्याण व्हावे यासाठी कविता अगत्य करावी. ती कविता कशी असावी तें आतां सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: To gain that One who uplifts this `other/all' (ie. that atma purush), this poem should be carefully and lovingly made. One should therefore `speak' this poem, `I am He'.

owis.original: जेणें घडे भगवद्भक्ती । जेणें घडे विरक्ती । ऐसिया कवित्वाची युक्ती । आधीं वाढवावी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या कवितेनें भगवंताची भक्ति वाढेल आणि विरक्ति उत्पन्न होईल अशा प्रकारची कविता पुष्कळ करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to mula maya (ie. this poem) there arises devotion to God; due to this poem, one becomes disinterested in worldly desires. Due to this poem, the `word' that is at the beginning (ie. in the beginning was the Word), is made to grow and grow (maharaj- become so big you pervade the whole world).

owis.original: क्रियेवीण शब्दज्ञान । तया न मनिती सज्जन । म्हणौनी देव प्रसन्न । अनुतापें करावा ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वानुभवावांचून जें नुसतें शब्दज्ञान असतें त्यास संतसज्जन किंमत देत नाहीत. म्हणून अनुतापानें देव प्रसन्न करुन घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Without this action of the `word' (`He does everything') one cannot accept that Reality (first be established in this `I am'). By the surrender of one's ego, one will receive this blessing from God.

owis.original: देवाचेन प्रसन्नपणें । जें जें घडे बोलणें । तें तें अत्यंत श्र्लाघ्यवाणें । या नाव प्रासादिक ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव प्रसन्न झाल्यावर जें शब्द येतात, जें जें कांहीं वाणींतून प्रगट होते, तें सारें अतिशय चांगलें असतें. त्याला प्रासादिक असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When one receives this blessing from God (ie. purush) then, this `speech' of mula maya appears. `I am' is this inspired poem and it is the praising of that Reality.

owis.original: धीट पाठा प्रसादिक । ऐसें बोलती अनेक । तरी हा त्रिविध विवेक । बोलिजेला ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: धीट, पाठ आणि प्रासादिक असें कवितेचें तीन प्रकार आहेत. हें तीन प्रकार काय आहेत तें सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the bold poem, the learned poem and this inspired poem. But when this `speech' is forgotten then, there will be numerous different forms in this world. Therefore these three forms of vivek should be `spoken'.

owis.original: धीट म्हणिजे धीटपणें केलें । जें जें आपुल्या मनास आलें । बळेंचि कवित्व रचिलें । या नाव धीट बोलिजे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: धीटपणानें केलेलें काव्य तें धीट कवित्व होय. आपल्या मनांत जें कांहीं येते तें काव्यांत प्रगट करणें यास धीट काव्य म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The bold poem gets formed when one is resolute and determined. Then no matter what comes to your mind, still you remain determined and with great effort, this `I am' poem is composed. Thus, if one is bold and throws off the `many' thoughts then, this `I am' will be `spoken' (in the beginning continuous effort is required to leave these thoughts you have created of this imagined world and perceive this `I am'; see 13.10.23).

owis.original: पाठ म्हणिजे पाठांतर । बहुत पाहिलें ग्रंथांतर । तयासारिखा उतार । आपणहि केला ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाठ म्हणजे पाठांतर पुष्कळ ग्रंथ वाचून त्यामधील काव्यासारखी कविता आपण करणें यास पाठ कवित्व असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The learned poem means this `all' has been understood from that which one has learned and remembered within the scriptures (they tell us this world is illusory, a figment of our imagination and by the practice of neti, neti this `all' is come upon). It is a medicine similar to that Reality but it has been created by you. (Therefore these are two ways to gain this `speech' of mula maya; and then afterwards the `speech' of this inspired poem arises effortlessly from that purush and no more sadhana is required)

owis.original: सीघ्रचि कवित्व जोडिलें । दृष्टी पडिलें तें चि वर्णिलें । भक्तिवांचून जें केलें । त्या नाव धीटपाठ ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तत्काळ कविता करण्याची शक्ति संपादन केली, म्हणजें मग जें दिसेल त्यावर कविता रचली जाते. जें भगवंताच्या भक्तिशिवाय केलें जाते त्यास धीट कवित्व म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But when a poem has been put together quickly from whatever has fallen in front of one's vision then, this `all' ceases and that Reality gets described in words. Then there is this description void of any devotion and this `I am' becomes a poem collected from the things of this world and learnt from the things of this world (you may have understood this `all' but then the mind objectifies and sees something and describes it. "Oh, there is this and that and want to have this and learn more about that" This is called a bold and learned poem).

owis.original: कामिक रसिक श्रृंघारिक । वीर हास्य प्रस्ताविक । कौतुक विनोद अनेक । या नाव धीटपाठ ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जी कविता कामिक व रंगेल आहे, जिच्यामध्यें श्रृंगार, वीर, हास्य, पश्र्चाताप, कौतुक, विनेद इत्यादि अनेक विषय असतात त्या कवितेला धीटपाठ कविता म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This type of poem is sensual, sentimental and passionate; and it is courageous, humorous and sad. Then there is curiosity, delight and surprise and this wonder of `I am' becomes the appreciation of the numerous different forms in this world and so this `speech' becomes a poem that is bold and learned for only the things that are illusory.

owis.original: मन जालें कामाकार । तैसेचि निघती उद्गार । धीटपाठें परपार । पाविजेत नाहीं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कवीचें मन कामवासनेंने भरुन कामाकार झालें, म्हणजे त्यास अनुसरुन त्यांचे उद्गार निघतात. अशा धीटपाठ कवितेनें परमार्थ साधत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: 11. This type of poem is sensual, sentimental and passionate; and it is courageous, humorous and sad. Then there is curiosity, delight and surprise and this wonder of `I am' becomes the appreciation of the numerous different forms in this world and so this `speech' becomes a poem that is bold and learned for only the things that are illusory.

owis.original: व्हावया उदरशांती । करणे लागे नरस्तुती । तेथें केली जे वित्पत्ती । त्या नाव धीटपाठ ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पोटांतील भुकेची आग शांत करण्यासाठीं कवीला माणसांची स्तुती करावी लागते. अशी नरस्तती करण्यासाठीं केलेली कविता  म्हणजे धीटपाठ कविता होय.
owis.englishMeaning: These are composed to flatter. These are required for the business of keeping the belly satisfied. `There' had become mula maya and when afterwards this eloquently expounds upon the shasthras then, this `I am' becomes the bold and learned poems about the empty and false (then this `I am' poem becomes the thoughts of this gross existence).

owis.original: कवित्व नसावें धीटपाठ । कवित्व नसावें खटपट । कवित्व नसावें उद्धट । पाषांडमत ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कविता धीटपाठ नसावी. कविता ओढूनताणून केलेली नसावी. कविता उद्धट किंवा पाखंड मत प्रतिपादन करणारी नसावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Your poem should not be such a bold and learned poem. This poem should not trouble and squabble. This poem should not be arrogant, sacrilegious opinions.

owis.original: कवित्व नसावें वादांग । कवित्व नसावें रसभंग । कवित्व नसावें रंगभंग । दृष्टांतहीन ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कवितेंत वादविवादाचें अंग असूं नये. कवितेंमध्यें रस भंग व रंगाचा बेरंग नसावा. दृष्टांतावाचून कविता असूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem should not be arguments. This poem should not break the essence. This poem should not break the splendour and be lacking in this `end of the visible' (ie. end of objectivity).

owis.original: कवित्व नसावें पाल्हाळ । कवित्व नसावें बाष्कळ । कवित्व नसावें कुटीळ । लक्षुनियां ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कवितेंत पाल्हाळ व पाचकळपणा नसावा. वाईट किंवा लबाड लोकांना उद्देशून कविता करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem should not be rambling and this poem should not be frivolous or unrestra- ined. This poem should not be malicious and spiteful gossip (ie. the bold and learned poems are composed when one sees a gross world through the senses and the mind takes this resolutely to heart and dwells upon and remembers these objects only).

owis.original: हीन कवित्व नसावें । बोलिलेंचि न बोलावें । छंदभंग न करावें । मुद्राहीन ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हलक्या दर्जाचे कवित्व नसावें. कवितेंत तेंच तेंच पुनः पुनः सांगितलेले नसावें. काव्यशास्त्राचे नियम मोडणारें कवित्व नसावें. छंद, मात्रा, वृत्त वगैरेंचें नियम मोडूं नयेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Your poem should not become these inferior poems and then afterwards this `speech' even should not be `spoken' (the `word' should merge within the thoughtless). There should be no break in your fond regard for this inspired poem or any lack of attention.

owis.original: वित्पत्तीहीन तर्कहीन । कळाहीन शब्दहीन । भक्तिज्ञानवैराग्यहीन । कवित्व नसावें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विद्याविलास, तर्क, कला, उचित शब्द, भक्ति, ज्ञान, वैराग्य यांचा अभाव असणारें कवित्व नसावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Poetry should not be devoid of this knowledge of the scriptures (neti, neti) nor devoid of *logic, nor this unique art of knowing. It should not be devoid of this `word' or of devotion/bhakti, knowledge/gnyan and renunciation/vairagya. *(With just a little thought we will come to understand that the things we see with our eyes cannot be the truth)

owis.original: भक्तिहीन जें कवित्व । तेंचि जाणावें ठोंबें मत । आवडीहीन जें वगत्रुत्व । कंटाळवाणें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या काव्यांत भक्ति नाहीं तें अडाणी काव्य समजावें. जें काव्य भक्तिच्या आवडी विरहीत असतें तें कंटाळवाणें होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When this mula maya has become these poems void of any devotion then, you should know that that Reality has become just like these foolish thoughts. When eloquent speech is lacking in love then, it is merely tiresome and mind-numbing.

owis.original: भक्तिविण जो अनुवाद । तोचि जाणावा विनोद । प्रीतीविण संवाद । घडे केवी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भक्तिशिवाय केलेली काव्यरचना हें मनोरंजनच समजावें. भगवंताच्या प्रेमाखेरीज त्याच्याशी खरा वार्तालाप होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When lacking in devotion/bhakti then, there is parrot-like repetition and that should be known as only amusement. How can there be a silent dialogue between the guru and disciple when there is no love?

owis.original: असो धीट पाठ तें ऐसें । नाथिलें अहंतेचे पिसें । आतां प्रासादिक तें कैसें । सांगिजेल ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असो. धीटपाठ कविता ही अशी असते, मिथ्या असलेल्या अहंकाराला लागलेलें तें एक प्रकारचे वेडच आहे. प्रासादिक कविता कशी असते तें आतां सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: So be it, such is the case when that Reality becomes the bold and learned poems. It is the madness of the non-existent ego. Now be present and just listen to how this inspired poem becomes that thoughtless Self.

owis.original: वैभव कांता कांचन । जयास वाटे हें वमन । अंतरीं लागलें ध्यान । सर्वोत्तमाचें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला वैभव, पैसा आणि कामवासना तिन्ही वांतीसारखीं वाटतात, ज्याच्या हृदयांत भगवंताचे ध्यान अखंड चालूं असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When that mula maya (ie. this poem `I am') feels that the glories of woman and gold are like vomit, then in this inner space there is the meditation of that purush.

owis.original: जयास घडीनें घडी । लागे भगवंतीं आवडी । चढती वाढती गोडी । भगवद्भजनाची ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्षणाक्षणाला ज्यास भगवंताचें स्मरण होतें आणि त्यामुळें त्याला असलेली भगवंताची आवड वाढत जातें, ज्याची भगवंताची भक्ति आणि भक्तिची गोडी अधिकाधिक वाढत जाते,
owis.englishMeaning: Then that purush is each and every moment lovingly attached to God and His bhajans rise higher and grow deeper (He is in Himself).

owis.original: जो भगवद्भजनेंवीण । जाऊं नेदी येक क्षण । सर्वकाळ अंतःकरण । भक्तिरंगें रंगलें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताच्या भजनावांचून एक क्षणदेखिल तो वाया जाऊं देत नाहीं, ज्याचें अंतःकरण सदैव भगवंताच्या प्रेमांत रंगलें आहे,
owis.englishMeaning: That purush does not allow a moment to pass without the bhajan of God and in this `time of the all' His antah-karana delights in the splendour of no-otherness.

owis.original: जया अंतरीं भगवंत । अचळ राहिला निवांत । तो स्वभावें जें बोलत । तें ब्रह्मनिरुपण ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आणि ज्याच्या अंतर्यामी भगवंत अचल आणि स्थिर असतो, असा एकच पुरुष जें सहज बोलतों तें ब्रह्मनिरुपण होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this mula maya is that God (ie. mula purush) within this inner space and stays steady and silent. When that purush knows this natural `speech' then, there will be that discourse of brahman.

owis.original: अंतरीं बैसला गोविंद । तेणें लागला भक्तिछंद । भक्तीविण अनुवाद । आणीक नाहीं ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतःकरणामध्यें भगवंतानें ठाण मांडल्यानें अशा पुरुषाला भक्तिचा छंद लागतो. त्यामुळें तो भक्तवांचून दुसरें कांहींच बोलत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: When you understand that govinda Himself dwells within you then, there is a longing for His devotion. Without this devotion there is nothing more than mere repetition (maharaj- you get up, you eat, you go to work, you come back, you eat and then you sleep; and in the morning you get up and do it all over again. Don't you ever get tired of it?).

owis.original: आवडी लागली अंतरीं । तैसीच वदे वैखरी । भावें करुणाकीर्तन करी । प्रेमभरें नाचतु ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतर्यामीं ज्याची आवड लागलेली असते, त्याला अनुसरुन त्याची वाणी बोलूं लागते. मोठ्या प्रेमानें व श्रद्धेनें तोकरुणारसानें भरलेलें किर्तन करतो. कीर्तनामध्यें प्रेम अनिवार होऊन तों नाचतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When in this inner space there is that fondness for His devotion then, this will be expressed in your outer speech. Then one `sings' kirtana with understanding and with overflowing love one dances (when the whole world is myself then, the `all' is myself dancing in delight).

owis.original: भगवंतीं लागलें मन । तेणें नाठवे देहभान । शंका लज्जा पळोन । दुरी ठेली ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचे मन भगवंताला चिकटल्यानें त्याला देहभान राहात नाहीम. शंका व लाज त्याच्यापासून दूर पळून जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the mind is merged in God then, body consciousness is not remembered and all doubts and shame run far away.

owis.original: तो प्रेमरंगें रंगला । तो भक्तिमदें मातला । तेणें अहंभाव घातला । पायांतळीं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रेमच्या रंगानें रंगलेला आणि भक्तीच्या कैफानें मस्त झालेला असा तो स्वतःचा अहंभाव आपल्या पायाखालीं तुडवितो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that purush is immersed in this ocean of love. Then that purush is intoxicated by the wine of devotion and due to this, the ego feeling is knocked off its feet.

owis.original: गात नाचत निशंक । तयास कैचे दिसती लोक । दृष्टीं त्रैलोक्यनायेक । वसोन ठेला ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो अगदी निःशंक मनानें गातो व नाचतो. अजूबाजूच्या लोकांचे अस्तित्व त्याला भासत नाहीं. कारण त्याच्या नजरेमध्यें त्रैलोक्यनायक भगवंत भरुन राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: He `sings and dances' throughout this world without fear and without doubt. How can that purush see a visible world when He is established as the Master of all the three worlds?

owis.original: ऐसा भगवंतीं रंगला । आणीक कांहीं नलगे त्याला । स्वइच्छा वर्णूं लागला । ध्यान कीर्ती प्रताप ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें जो भगवंताच्या ठिकाणी रंगून जातो त्याला कशाचीही वासना शिल्लक उरत नाहीं. मग तो स्वछंदपणें भगवंताची ध्यान मूर्ती, त्याची कीर्ति आणि त्याचा प्रताप यांचें वर्णन करुं लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is His delight in God that, that purush does not even need this `thing'. His `wish' is His praise of God and His meditation is His own fame and glory.

owis.original: नाना ध्यानें नाना मूर्ती । नाना प्रताप नाना कीर्ती । तयापुढें नरस्तुती । त्रुणतुल्य वाटे ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवमताच्या नाना प्रकारच्या ध्यानमूर्ति, सगुण मूर्ति, कीर्ति आणि पराक्रम वर्णन करण्यापुढें माणसाची स्तुति करणें त्याला अगदीं कःपदार्थ वाटतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then the `many' poems and there is God's form `I am' ; there are the `many' poems and there is God's sacred image, `I am everywhere'. There are the `many' poems and His glory and there are the `many' poems and His pervasiveness. But before that purush, the praise of man is as about as much worth as a piece of straw.

owis.original: असो ऐसा भगवद्भक्त । जो ये संसारीं विरक्त । तयास मानिती मुक्त । साधुजन ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सार्‍या संसारापासून विरक्त असणारा असा तो वर वर्णन केलेला भगवद्भक्त असतो. त्याला संतमंडळीं मुक्त पुरुष मानतात.
owis.englishMeaning: So be it! Like this is the devotee of God. When that purush is this desireless thoughtlessness within samsar, then He is the liberated sadhu.

owis.original: त्याचे भक्तीचें कौतुक । तया नाव प्रसादिक । सहज बोलतां विवेक । प्रगट होय ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा पुरुषाची भक्ति जेव्हां शब्दरुप घेऊन प्रगट होते, तेव्हां तिला प्रासादिक म्हणतात, त्याच्या सहज बोलण्यांत आत्मानात्मविवेक प्रगट होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this wonder of devotion comes to that purush then, there is this inspired poem. When there is this natural `speech' then, that is vivek.

owis.original: ऐका कवित्वलक्षण । केलेंच करुं निरुपण । जेणे निवे अंतःकर्ण । श्रोतयांचें ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां उत्तम कवितेचे लक्षण ऐका. मागें सांगून झालें आहें तेंच पुनः सांगतों. तें सांगितल्यानें श्रोत्यांचें अंतःकरण तृप्त होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Listen with the attention of this poem. Listen, for then there is that discourse with brahman and due to this, the antah-karana of the listener becomes still.

owis.original: कवित्व असावें निर्मळ । कवित्व असावें सरळ । कवित्व असावें प्रांजळ । अन्वयाचें ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम कविता निर्मल, सरळ आणि मागचा पुढचा संदर्भ स्पष्ट करणारी असावी.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem should be pure. This poem should be easy and simple. This poem should have the clarity of this `I am' connection.

owis.original: कवित्व असावें भक्तिबळें । कवित्व असावें अर्थागळें । कवित्व असावें वेगळें । अहंतेसी ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कविता भक्तीच्या भरांतून आलेली असावी. ती मोठ्या आशयानें भरलेलीं असावी. तिच्यामध्यें अहंकाराचा मागमूस नसावा.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem should have the power of no-otherness. This poem should be full of the meaning (maharaj words are empty, the meaning is paramatma). This poem should be void of body consciousness.

owis.original: कवित्व असावें कीर्तिवाड । कवित्व असावें रम्य गोड । कवित्व असावें जाड । प्रतापविषीं ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कवितेंत भगवंताची भरपूर कीर्ति, स्तुती असावी. कविता मन प्रसन्न करणारी व गोड असावी. कवितेमध्यें देवाचे पराक्रम काठोकाठ भरलेला असावा.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem should increase ones pervasiveness. This poem is auspicious and beau- tiful. This poem should be overflowing with His glory and splendour.

owis.original: कवित्व असावें सोपे । कवित्व असावें अल्परुपें । कवित्व असावें सुल्लपें । चरणबंद ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कविता समजायला सोपी असावी. तशीच ती लहान असावी. कविता क्लिष्ट नसावी. कवितेचे चरण नियमाप्रमाणें बांधलेलें असावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem is the most simple of poems. This poem is the subtlest of forms. This poem is the easily attained binding to His feet.

owis.original: मृदु मंजुळ कोमळ । भव्य अद्भुत विशाळ । गौल्य माधुर्य रसाळ । भक्तिरसें ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कवितेमध्यें मुख्य भक्तिरस असावा. त्या भक्तिरसानें कविता मृदु, मंजुळ, कोमल, तशीच भव्य,  अद्भुत, विशाळ आणि व्यवस्थित रचलेली, मधुर आणि रसानें भरलेली अशी असावी.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem should be soft, pleasant to hear and delicate. It should be this expansive, splendid existence, beyond this world. It should have the loving sweet taste that has been dipped in the sweet juice of devotion.

owis.original: अक्षरबंद पदबंद । नाना चातुर्य प्रबंद । नाना कौशल्यता छंदबंद । धाटी मुद्रा अनेक ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम कवितेमध्यें, पुढील अनेक गोष्टी असाव्यात. अक्षरबंध, पदबंध, म्हणजे चित्रकाव्य, नाना चतुर रचना, चातुर्यानें रचलेलें निरनिराळें छंद, बंध, धाटी, मुद्रा,
owis.englishMeaning: But when that Eternal and Absolute is bound then, there are the `many' acquired wisdoms. Then there are `many' skills and the bindings of longing and then there are `many' different attentions and different shapes.

owis.original: नाना युक्ती नाना बुद्धी । नाना कळा नाना सिद्धी । नाना अन्वये साधी । नाना कवित्व ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारचे उचित उपाय, चांगलें विचार, सुंदर कलाप्रकार, लहानमोठ्या सिद्धी, नाना कार्यकारण भावा, वेगवेगळे छंद,
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are the `many' tricks and the `many' buddhi; there are the `many' arts and the `many' accomplishments; then there are the `many' connections and the `many' poems.

owis.original: नाना साहित्य दृष्टांत । नाना तर्क धात मात । नाना संमती सिद्धांत । पूर्वपक्षेंसीं ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना तर्हेची माहिती, निरनिराळे दृष्टांत, तर्कप्रकार, कथा व कहाण्या अनेक आधारवचनें, पूर्वपक्षासगट सिद्धांत,
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are the `many' suitable examples and the `many' achievements of logic and understanding. This original hypothesis (`I am') is the `many' opinions and it is the establishment of siddhant (I do not exist).

owis.original: नाना गती नाना वित्पत्ती । नाना मती नाना स्फूर्ति । नाना धारणा नाना धृती । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारच्या अवस्थांचें वर्णन, भिन्न भिन्न क्षेत्रांतील विद्वता, कल्पना व स्फूर्ति यांचे निरनिराळे प्रकार, अनेक तर्‍हेच्या धारणा, आणि धैर्याचे प्रकार या व असल्या गोष्टींचें सुंदर वर्णन ज्यांत आढळते ती उत्तम कविता होय.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' states and the `many' utterances of knowledge; there are the `many' understanding and the `many' inspirations; there are the `many' imaginings and the `many' determinations and there is this poetry `I am He'.

owis.original: शंका आशंका प्रत्योत्तरें । नाना काव्यें शास्त्राधारें । तुटे संशये निर्धारें । निर्धारितां ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम कवितेमध्यें शंका कुशंका, व आशंका मांडून प्रत्युत्तरानीं त्यांचें निरसन केलेलें असावें. अनेक काव्यसंग्रह व शास्त्रग्रंथ यांच्या वचनांचा आधार देऊन निश्र्चित निर्णय करावा. आणि अशारीतीनें संशय मोडून टाकावेत.
owis.englishMeaning: This poem is the reply to the doubts and fears and then, the `many' poems are this beautiful poem that supports the scriptures (neti, neti). Due to this poem, this doubt of the `all' will surely be removed by thoughtlessness.

owis.original: नाना प्रसंग नाना विचार । नाना योग नाना विवर । नाना तत्वचर्चासार । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुढील गोष्टी ज्या साहित्यामध्यें आढळतात त्यास खरें उत्तम काव्य म्हणतां येते. उत्तम कवितेमध्यें अनेक प्रसंग,विचार, योग, स्पष्टीकरणें , तत्वांबद्दल चर्चेचा सारांश,
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' occasions and there are the `many' thoughts; there are the `many' yogas and there are the `many' investigations; there are the `many' essences of philosophical discussion and there is this poem, `I am'.

owis.original: नाना साधनें पुरश्र्चरणें । नाना तपें तीर्थाटणें । नाना संदेह फेडणें । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: साधनें, पुरश्र्चरणें, तपश्र्चर्येचें प्रकार, तीर्थाटनें आणि अनेक शंकांचें निरसन असावें.
owis.englishMeaning: There are there the `many' sadhanas and their destruction; there are the `many' penances and pilgrimages and their destruction; there are the `many' doubts and their destruction due to this poem, `I am'.

owis.original: जेणें अनुताप उपजे । जेणें लोकिक लाजे । जेणें ज्ञान उमजे । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या कवितेच्या योगानें अनुताप उत्पन्न होतो, लौकिक जीवनाची म्हणजे देहबुद्धीच्या स्वार्थी जीवनाची लाज वाटते, आत्मज्ञान काय हें बरोबर ध्यानांत येते,
owis.englishMeaning: Due to mula maya, repentance/surrender arises. Due to mula maya, shame for the worldly arises. Due to mula maya, there is the understanding of knowledge and this is the poem `I am'.

owis.original: जेणें ज्ञान हें प्रबळे । जेणे वृत्ती हे मावळे । जेणें भक्तिमार्ग कळे । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्ञानाचा उत्कर्ष होतो. वृत्ति मावळतात, भक्तोमार्ग आकलन होऊं लागतो,
owis.englishMeaning: Due to mula maya, there is an abundance of knowledge. Due to mula maya this knowing vritti gets dissolved in thoughtlessness. Due to mula maya, the path of devotion is understood and this is the inspired poem.

owis.original: जेणे देहबुद्धी तु्टे । जेणे भवसिंधु आटे । जेणें भगवंत प्रगटे । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहबुद्धी नाश पावते, दृश्यभवसागर आटतो, भगवंत प्रगट होतो,
owis.englishMeaning: Due to mula maya, body intellect is severed and due to mula maya, the ocean of mundane worldly existence is dried up. Due to mula maya, there is the manifestation of God and this is the inspired poem.

owis.original: जेणें सद्बुद्धि लागे । जेणें पाषांड भंगे । जेणें विवेक जागे । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सद्बुद्धी अंगी जडते,आत्मज्ञानविरोधी मते भंग पावतात. आत्मानात्मविवेक जागा होतो,
owis.englishMeaning: Due to mula maya, there is the establishment of a pure buddhi. Due to mula maya, the atheist thoughts are broken and due to mula maya, vivek is aroused and there is the inspired poem.

owis.original: जेणें सद्वस्तु भासे । जेणें भास हा निरसे । जेणें भिन्नत्व नासे । या नाव कवित्व ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सद्वस्तु, परब्रह्म प्रचितीत येते, मिथ्या दृश्य भास नाहींसा होतो. भेद सगळा नाहींसा होतो,
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this inspired poem that pure Self appears as this `I am. And due to this in- spired poem, this appearance `I am' is dissolved in thoughtlessness. Due to this inspired poem separateness is forever destroyed.

owis.original: जेणें होये समाधान । जेणें तुटे संसारबंधन । जया मानिती सज्जन । तया नाव कवित्व ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवाचें समाधान होतेम, संसाराचें बंधन तुटते, आणि ज्या कवितेला संत मान्यता देतात ती कविता उत्तम होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this inspired poem there is complete contentment and due to this inspired poem, the bondage of samsar is broken. This is why this inspired poem is honoured by the Saints.

owis.original: ऐसें कवित्वलक्षण । सांगतां तें असाधारण । परंतु कांहींयेक निरुपण । बुझावया केलें ॥ ५४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम कवितेचें लक्षण खरोखर सांगणें कठिण आहे. कारण तें फारच विलक्षण आहे. पण तिचें स्वरुप कांहींसे लक्षांत यावें म्हणून येथें थोडेसें वर्णन केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the attention of this poem then, that thoughtless nirgun can be told. But this discourse of the One who is within everyone has been covered over by the `many' bold and learned poems. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: कलयुगीं कीर्तन करावें । केवळ कोमळ कुशळ गावें । कठीण कर्कश कुर्टे सांडावें । येकीकडे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कलियुगांत कीर्तन करावें. त्यांत फक्त कोमळ गावें. पण कौशल्यानें गांवें. कठोर, कर्कश किंवा चोरटें गांवू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: In this kali3era, kirtana should be made and that pure knowledge should be sung with skill and tenderness. Due to this, the difficult, harsh and morose will be left aside by that One.

owis.original: खटपट खुंटून टाकावी । खळखळ खळांसीं न करावी । खरें खोटें खवळों नेदावी । वृत्ती आपुली ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भांडणतंटा सोडून द्यावा. दुष्टाबरोबर विरोध करुं नये. खरें खोटें करण्याच्या भानगडींत आपली वृत्ती भडकूं देऊं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: The continuous chatter should be gathered up and thrown out. The bothersome wrangling and toil should be put to an end, and rights and wrongs should not be allowed to affect your own knowing vritti.

owis.original: गर्वगाणें गाऊं नये । गातां गातां गळों नये । गोप्य गुज गर्जो नये । गुण गावे॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अभिमानानें गाणें गाऊं नये. गातागाता थकून मध्येंच गाणें अर्धवट सोडूं नये. कोणाची गुप्त गोष्ट लोकांत उघड सांगूं नये. दुसर्‍याचे गुणच सांगावें.
owis.englishMeaning: One should not `sing' proudly and there should be no deterioration in this `singing'. To attain its essence, this secret whisper should not be roared.

owis.original: घष्टणी घिसणी घस्मरपणें । घसर घसरुं घसा खाणें । घुमघुमों चि घुमणें । योग्य नव्हे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: धसधसा,घिसघिस करीत आणि घसा सारखा साफ करीत व खांकरत गाणें गाऊं नये. घशाला ताण देऊन गाणें गाऊं नये. कीर्तनांत अंगांत आल्यासारखें बोलूं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Friction and squabbling should be gulped down. Deterioration should be halted and lose should be swallowed up. It serves no useful purpose to repeatedly mull over the same old thoughts.

owis.original: नाना नामें भगवंताचीं । नाना ध्यानें सगुणाची । नाना कीर्तनें कीर्तीचीं । अद्भुत करावीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भगवंताची नाना प्रकारचीं नांवें घ्यावी. भगवंताचे अनेक सगुणरुपांचे वर्णन करावें. भगवंताच्या अनेक प्रकारच्या कीर्तीचे वर्णन करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' names, on account of this `name' of God; there are the `many' 3Fourth era, time when we experience the fruits of our past actions (body consciousness) images, on account of this image of sagun; there are the `many' songs, on account of this kirtana of the One who pervades everywhere; therefore this marvellous wonder of `I am' should be made.

owis.original: चकचक चुकावेना । चाट चावट चळावेना । चरचर चुरचुर लागेना । ऐसें करावें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चक् चक् करण्याची वेळ येईल अशी चूक करुं नये. लबाड व चावट लोक चेकाळतील असें करुं नये. लोकांच्या मनाला फार लागेल असें बोलूं नये.
