owis.marathiMeaning: गावगुंडी केल्यानें ब्राह्मणांना अशी हीन दशा प्राप्त झाली. विष्णूनें श्रीवत्स ही खूण मिरविली अशी ब्राह्मणांची थोरवी होती. त्याच विष्णूनें परशुरामाचा अवतार घेऊन त्यांना शाप दिला.
owis.englishMeaning: That real brahmin has been drowned by the head of the village (the ego is the master of this body). Lord vishnu had proudly worn the *mark where the brahmin kicked him, but then that same vishnu incarnated as parashuram and cursed the brahmins. *(shri- vatsa; a true brahmin called bhrugu had kicked off vishnu ie. knowledge and attained vignyan)

owis.original: आम्हीहि तेचि ब्राह्मण । दुःखें बोलिलें हें वचन । वडिल गेले ग्रामणी करुन । आम्हां भोंवते ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आम्ही देखील ब्राह्मणच आहोत त्यांच्या दुःस्थितीबद्दल दुःखानें बोललो. वडील माणसें गांवगुंडी करुन गेली, ते आम्हांला सध्या भोवते आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: We also are that brahmin (ie. Knower of brahman), but this divine `speech' and thoughtlessness have been made to suffer. Our father (ie. atma) has been destroyed and all around us there is this village leader.

owis.original: अतांचे ब्राह्मणीं काये केलें । अन्न मिळेना ऐसें जालें । तुम्हा बहुतांचे प्रचितीस आलें । किंवा नाहीं ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बरें पण सध्याचें ब्राह्मणसुद्धा कोठें नीट वागत आहेत ? खायला अन्न मिळत नाहीं अशी त्यांची दशा आहे. मला वाटते हे तुमच्यापैकी पुष्कळांच्या अनुभवास आलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: How can this `I am' within the brahmin be created when one does not take this divine `food' of the `all' (ie. understand, nothing is there). Tell me, have you brought this experience or have you not?

owis.original: बरें वडिलांस काये म्हणावें । ब्राह्मणाचें अदृष्ट जाणावें । प्रसंगें बोलिलें स्वभावें । क्ष्मा केलें पाहिजे ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाऊं द्या वडील माणसांना दोष देऊं नये. त्याचा काय उपयोग ? आपलाच पूर्व ठेवा वाईट आहे. असें म्हणावें. सहज विषय निघाला म्हणून हें बोललो त्याबद्दल क्षमा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: Why should the best guna say all this nonsense to that oldest and wisest (atma, where words come back)? One should know that unseen brahmin. Therefore this `all' should make this `speech' and then have patience and forgiveness (let all come and go, and say nothing). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Akhanda Dhyan Nirupan (A Discourse on Uninterrupted Meditation)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: बरें ऐसा प्रसंग आला । जाला तो होऊन गेला । आतां तरी ब्राह्मणीं आपणाला । शाहाणें करावें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बरें, अशी अवस्था झाली खरी पण झालें तें होऊन गेलें. आतां ब्राह्मणांनी स्वतःला शहाणें करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That pure knowledge has become this `all' connection. And when this connection appears then, that atma comes and goes (ie. where is knowledge when you sleep?). Now therefore, through wisdom we should be true brahmins.

owis.original: देव पुजावा विमळहस्तीं । तेणें भाग्य पाविजे समस्तीं । मूर्ख अभक्त वेस्तीं । दरिद्र भोगिजे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पवित्र हातांनीं देवाची पूजा करावी. तसें केलें तर सगळ्यांना भाग्याची प्राप्ती होईल. जे अभक्त असतात ते अव्यवस्थित मूर्ख करंटेपण, दारिद्र्य भोगतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Our puja to God should be done with *clean hands. Due to this, that great blessing that is within this `all' will be attained. If one does not have this devotion then, due to foolishness one will suffer misery and deprivation. *(maharaj- to understand I am not the body, is to have clean hands) (siddharameshwar maharaj- puja means to know)

owis.original: आधीं देवास वोळखावें । मग अनन्यभावें भजावें । अखंड ध्यानचि धरावें । सर्वोत्तमाचें ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम देवाला ओळखावें. मग अनन्यपणें त्याची भक्ति करावी. त्या सर्वोत्तमाचें अगदी अखंड ध्यान धरावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That God at the source should be recognized and when there is the understanding of no-otherness then, His bhajans are being made. You should hold firmly that unbroken meditation of the One who is greater than this `all' (He is God or the purush).

owis.original: सर्वांमधें जो उत्तम । तया नाव सर्वोत्तम । आत्मानात्मविवेकवर्म । ठाईं पाडावें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वांमध्यें जो उत्तम असतो, त्याला सर्वोत्तम असें म्हणतात. तोच आत्मा असून बाकीचें सारें तें अनात्म होय. आत्मानात्मविवेकाचें हें रहस्य नीटपणें आकलन करुन घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this `all' there is that purush and therefore He is greater than this `all'. He is the essence of atma/anatma vivek and He should be found (ie. thoughtlessness).

owis.original: जाणजाणों देह रक्षी । आत्मा द्रष्टा अंतरसाक्षी । पदार्थमात्रास परीक्षी । जाणपणें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा द्रष्टा आहे अंतरसाक्षी आहे, जाणीरुपानें तो देहाचे रक्षण करतो. जाणिवेच्या साधनानें सर्व पदार्थांची परीक्षा तो करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The gross body is being protected by this continuous knowing and that atma is the seer or Witness within this inner space. And when this knowingness carefully exami- nes this moving `object' then, it extracts that essence. (This inner space or `all' is one moving form; and `here' the gross body and so many objects are not imagined as sepa- rate entities. Everything is known by that `all'-knowing atma within this one moving energy/chaitanya. The gross body and everything gets born, gets protected and dies within this knowing and that atma is the Knower of this inner space. By this intimate companionship of the Knower and known, this knowing is forever there. And only by remaining in this knowing, will this knowledge be properly examined and then, of its own accord, this knowledge will slip away)

owis.original: तो सकळ देहामधें वर्ततो । इंद्रियेंग्राम चेष्टवितो । प्रचितीनें प्रत्यये येतो । प्राणीमात्रीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो सर्व शरीरांत राहतो. इंद्रियांच्याकडून आपापलीं कामें करवून घेतो. सर्वांना अनुभवानें ही गोष्ट समजते.
owis.englishMeaning: The atma exists within this `all' body. That atma activates the assembled senses. On account of that atma within this sagun experience there comes that nirgun understan- ding to the one confined within the prana (ie. the jiva).

owis.original: प्राणीमात्रीं जगदांतरें । म्हणोनि राखावी अंतरें । दाता भोक्ता परस्परें । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका प्राण्याचें अंतःकरण म्हणजे सर्व जगाचें अंतःकरण होय. म्हणून सर्वांचें अंतःकरण सांभाळावें तें दुखवूं नये. मग दाता व भोक्ता; देणारा व घेणारा यांचा परस्पर प्रेमसंबंध जुळतो. मग सर्व कांहीं जुळून येते.
owis.englishMeaning: And on account of this inner space of the world (ie. `I am'), that atma stays in only the prana. That atma should be protected by you, by being this inner space (keep this understanding of this inner space of `I am' and that atma will remain near you; His presence will be felt and indirectly He will be experienced). He is the one who gives, He is the one who enjoys and at the same time, He is this `all thing' (He is everything).

owis.original: देव वर्ततो जगदांतरीं । तोचि आपुले अंतरीं । त्रैलोकींचे प्राणीमात्रीं । बरें पाहा ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो जाणीवरुप देव सर्व जगांत वावरतो तोच आपल्या अंतःकरणांत वास करतो. त्रैलोक्यांतील सर्व प्राण्यांत तोच जाणीवरुप देव राहतो हें नीट पाहावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That God who exists within this inner space of the world has Himself become this inner space and then He stays within the prana as only a jiva of these three worlds. Therefore understand thoughtlessness.

owis.original: मुळीं पाहाणर तो येकला । सकळां ठाईं विभागला । देहप्रकृतीनें जाला । भिन्न भिन्न ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुळांत पाहाणारा किंवा द्रष्टा असा तो एकच आहे. तो सर्वांत वाटलेला आहे. प्रत्येक प्राण्याच्या देहस्वभावामुळें तो वेगळा वाटतो.
owis.englishMeaning: At the source (ie. prakruti/purush), He is the one Knower and the known is His prakruti. Then this place of the `all' gets divided up and due to this body of prakruti, the many separate bodies appear.

owis.original: भिन्न भासे देहाकारें । प्रस्तुत येकचि अंतरें । बोलणें चालणें निर्धारें । त्यासीच पडे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येक प्राण्याच्या देहाच्या आकारानें तो वेगळा भासला, तरी देहाच्या पलीकडे अंतःकरणाच्या दृष्टीनें तो एकच आहे. माणसाचे बोलणें, चालणें वगैरे खात्रीनें तोच करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore it is He who has appeared as the many different body forms and yet even then, that One is with this inner space. This `speech'/existence and this moving form/knowledge happen due to that constant support of the atma. (Even when body consciousness is there still, that atma has never lost Himself and He stays within the inner space and perceives the world through the eyes of knowledge. It is the jiva who sees the many forms but He sees Himself. He is Himself, and He appears as the inner space or prakruti and the many divided forms also)

owis.original: आपुले पारिखे सकळ लोक । पक्षी स्वापद पश्र्वादिक । किडा मुंगी देहधारक । सकळ प्राणी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपली असणारी व आपलीं नसणारी सर्व माणसें, पक्षी, श्वापदें, पशु, किडे, मुंग्या वगैरे सगळे देहधारी प्राणी,
owis.englishMeaning: When our `all' world is the world of another (maharaj- every mind is a world) then, there are the birds, wild and domestic animals, ants and worms, and then this `all' is in the prana and is the holder of a gross body (every body gets born or is conceptualized of, within this `all' world. Every morning we say, `We awake" but knowledge awakes. But as soon as we start to think, this knowing is abandoned and at that moment, body consciousness erupts and covers over this `all' or `I am'. And taking ourselves to be a body, this `all' appears in the prana and there is a gross world full of `many' bodies/creatures).

owis.original: खेचर भूचर वनचर । नाना प्रकारें जळचर । चत्वार खाणी विस्तार । किती म्हणोन सांगावा ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खेचर म्हणजे आकाशांत फिरणारे भूचर,वनचर, नाना प्रकारचे जलचर, असें प्राण्यांचे चार प्रकार आहेत. त्यांचा विस्तार सगळा सांगणें कठीण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The creatures that fly, the plants in the ground and the wild animals and the water creatures are the ways of the `many'. They are the expansion of the four sources of birth and therefore the `many' thoughts should become thoughtless (when there is thoughtlessness then, no names or forms remain, this `all' even does not remain and there is One only and no other).

owis.original: समस्त जाणीवेनें वर्तती । रोकडी पाहावी प्रचिती । त्याची आपुली संगती । अखंड आहे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परंतु हे सगळे प्राणी जाणिवेनें वागतात. असा आपला साक्षात् अनुभव आहे. त्या जाणिवेची व आपली संगती अखंड असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Everything exists due to this knowing. But one should understand that atma who is within this ever present `experience'. Then our companionship with this knowing becomes that unbroken brahman.

owis.original: जगदांतरें वोळला धणी । किती येकवटील प्राणी । परी ते वोळायाची करणी । आपणापासीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाणीवरुप असा जगाचा अंतरात्मा हा खरा जगाचा स्वामी आहे. तो प्रसन्न करुन घ्यावा. म्हणजे मग पुष्कळ लोक आपल्या भोवतीं गोळा होतील. परंतु त्या स्वामीला प्रसन्न करुन घेण्याची कला आपल्या वागण्यांत आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this `experience', that Lord draws near to you and the `many' in the prana is gathered up into this one form. But this wondrous act of turning that Reality towards you is with you and you only and no-one else (when you stay in this experience then, God is felt to be close by but still out of sight. How can He be understood? You must go off)

owis.original: हें आपणाकडेच येतें । राजी राखिजे समस्तें । देहासि बरें करावें तें । आत्मयास पावे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगाचा स्वामी आपल्याला अनुकुल करुन घ्यावा. त्यासाठीं सर्वांना खूष ठेवावे. माणसाच्या देहाला बरें केलें म्हणजे तें त्याच्या आत्म्यापर्यंत पोहोचते.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that thoughtless atma that has appeared as you (ie. that thoughtless atma is the understanding, I do not exist, and He has become His reflection, `I am'). This `all' should therefore be carefully protected and when this knowing becomes thoughtless then, that atma will be attained.

owis.original: दुर्जन प्राणी त्यांतील देव । त्याचा लाताड स्वभाव । रागास आला जरी राव । तरी तंडों नये कीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुर्जन माणसाच्या अंतर्यामीही देव असतो. पण त्या माणसाचा स्वभाव लाथा झाडण्याचा असतो.समजा राजा रागावला तर आपण त्याच्याशी भांडत नाहीं. त्याचप्रमाणें दुर्जनाशी बरोबरी करुं नये.
owis.englishMeaning: When within that God there is a mind far from the atma then, the nature of that atma is to be confused and disruptive. Then if anger comes to that King, why should that atma argue with Him? (Let the world do whatever it likes. Understand, `He is Myself, why to argue with Him?' maharaj- keep your dirty nose out)

owis.original: प्रसंगीं सांडीच करणें । पुढें विवेकें विवरणें । विवेक सज्जनचि होणें । सकळ लोकीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रसंगानुसार त्या माणसाला किंवा त्या स्थानाला सोडून जाणें योग्य असतें. तसें शक्य असेल तर करावें व नंतर आपलें मन शांत करावें. अशारीतीनें सगळ्या लोकांमध्यें सज्जनपणा प्राप्तकरुन घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: When within this `I am' connection the actions are let go continually (ie. whatever comes, let it come; whatever goes let it go; this is the understanding `I am He') then, ahead there can be the investigation into that essence and non-essence. Due to such vivek, one becomes the Saint within this world of the `all'.

owis.original: आत्मत्वीं दिसतो भेद । हा अचघाचि देहसमंध । येका जीवनें नाना स्वाद । औषधीभेदें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा खरा एकच एक असतांना त्याच्या ठिकाणीं जो भेद दिसतो तो देहांमुळें दिसतो. पाणी एकच आहे, परंतु वनस्पतींच्या भेदानें त्यांत निरनिराळे स्वाद उत्पन्न होतात. आत्म्याचें तसेंच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But when atma-ness sees difference then, that pure thoughtlessness has become these `many' things and there is the connection to a gross body. Then due to this one water there are the `many' tastes in the `many' different plants.

owis.original: गरळ आणि अमृत जालें । परी आपपण नाहीं गेलें । साक्षत्वें आत्मयास पाहिलें । पाहिजे तैसें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जहाल वीष व अमृत यांचें स्वाद आणि कार्य अगदी भिन्न असतात. परंतु त्यांच्यामधील पाणीपणा मात्र जसाच्या तसाच असतो. त्याचप्रमाणें सर्व प्राण्यांत स्वरुपानें तसाच राहणार्‍या आत्म्याला साक्षीपणा हवाच हवा.
owis.englishMeaning: Then it can appear as poison or it can appear as nectar; still its water-ness is not lost. The atma as the Witness should be understood in the same way (ie. the atma can appear as the `many' objects or it can appear as this `I am' or immortal nectar ie. as long as knowledge is there, you cannot die. And still there is that One atma only).

owis.original: अंतरनिष्ठ जो पुरुष । तो अंतरनिष्ठेनें विशेष । जगामधें जो जगदीश । तो तयास वोळखे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो अंतरनिष्ठ पुरुष असतो, त्याची आत्मनिष्ठा विशेष प्रकारची असते. जगामध्यें व्यापून असणार्‍या जगदीशाला तो ओळखतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the inner steadfastness of that witnessing purush then, due to this inner steadfastness, there is that pure knowledge (and witnessing goes off). And then that Lord of the world within this world recognises Himself.

owis.original: नयनेंचि पाहावा नयेन । मनें शोधावें मन । तैसाचि हा भगवान् । सकळां घटीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण आपल्या डोळ्यानींच दुसर्‍याचा डोळा बघतो. मनानेंच मनाचा शोध घेतो. त्याचप्रमाणें स्वतःच्याच अंतःकरणांत असणार्‍या अंतरात्म्याच्या साधनानें सर्व प्राण्यांमध्यें भरलेला भगवंत पहावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Just as the eyes can be understood by the eyes (ie. in a reflection) and just as the mind can be searched by the mind, so too, that God can be understood within His `all' creation (ie. God can find Himself, if He searches for Himself. Then He will come to understand Himself by His reflection only).

owis.original: तेणेंविण कार्यभाग आडे । सकळ कांहीं तेणेंचि घडे । प्राणी विवेकें पवाडे । तेणेंचि योगें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या अंतरात्म्यावाचून कार्यभाग अडून राहतो. सर्व कांहीं त्याच्या सत्तेने घडते. त्याच्यामुळेंच माणूस मोठा विवेकसंपन्न बनतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Without Him nothing is accomplished and due to Him (as Witness) this `all thing' appears. This expansion that takes place in the prana through vivek (ie. the under- standing of the jiva becomes this knowledge/existence), is due to one's union with Him.

owis.original: जागृतीस व्यापार घडतो । समंध तयासीच पडतो । स्वप्नामधें घडे जो तो । येणेंचि न्यायें ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जागेपणीं आपण जी हालचाल करतो तिचा त्या अंतरात्म्याशीच संबंध असतो. स्वप्नामध्यें जें जें घडते त्याचा संबंधदेखील त्याच्याशीच असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma performs these activities in this waking state (ie. the dream within the dream) then, He loses His connection with His Reality. But in this original dream (ie. knowledge), that purush meets His own Self when there is thoughtlessness. (The dream is the pure sattwa guna; there is just knowing and when thoughtlessness comes then that atma meets Himself )

owis.original: अखंड ध्यानाचें लक्षण । अखंड देवाचें स्मरण । याचें कळतां विवरण । सहजचि घडे ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचे अखंड ध्यान राखावें. पण अखंड ध्यानाचे लक्षण म्हणजे देवाचे अखंड स्मरण होय. ध्यान आणि स्मरण यांचा परस्पर संबंध लक्षांत आला कीं अखंड स्मरण सहज घडते.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One unbroken God is this attention of meditation then, that unbro- ken God is remembering Himself and there is this `speech'. And when this `speech' is investigated then, that natural and unbroken God is accomplished.

owis.original: सहज सांडून सायास । हाचि कोणीयेक दोष । आत्मा सांडून अनात्म्यास । ध्यानीं धरिती ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हें सहज होणारें ध्यान सोडून निष्कारण श्रम करणें हा एक प्रकारचा दोष आहे. कारण लोक अंतरात्मा सोडून अनात्म्याचे ध्यान करण्याची धडपड करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If the natural is left aside and effort is made then, that One within everyone has committed a great wrong. Then that atma is let slip and in meditation the non-atma is firmly held in the mind.

owis.original: परी तें धरितांहि धरेना । ध्यानीं येती वेक्ति नाना । उगेंचि कष्टती मना । कासाविस करुनी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग प्रयत्न केला तरी ते ध्यान टिकत नाहीं. ध्यानामध्यें नाना व्यक्ति येतात. त्यामुळें मन कासावीस होतें. व जीवाला उगीचच कष्ट होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: To hold that Reality, there is not to be any holding. But in meditation the `many' forms appear and then that still and silent Self becomes a mind and that Reality suffers by making so much effort.

owis.original: मूर्तिध्यान करितां सायासें । तेथें येकाचें येकचि दिसे । भासों नये तेंचि भासे। विलक्षण ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठ्या सायासानें मूर्तीचे ध्यान करायला गेलें तर तेथें एकाचे एक दिसते. जें खरोखर भासायला नको, मनासमोर यायला नको, तेंच विलक्षण भासतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If you make an effort to meditate or place your attention on this image of God then, this sagun of that nirgun, is seen. Then that atma which should not appear, appears as something different.

owis.original: ध्यान देवाचे करावें । किंवा देवाल्याचे करावें । हेंचि बरें विवरावें । आपले ठाईं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यासाठीं आपण जें ध्यान करायचे तेम देवाचें करायचे कां देवालयाचे करायचें, याचा आपण आपल्याशी आधीं नीट विचार करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: Should one meditate on God or should one meditate on the temple? First you should know your place (ie. "I am not a body", `I am' and this is His temple) and then, you should investigate that thoughtless God.

owis.original: देह देऊळ आत्मा देव । । कोठें धरुं पाहाता भाव । देव वोळखोन जीव । तेथेंचि लावावा ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा देव असून देह त्याचें मंदिर आहे. त्यापैकीं आपली श्रद्धा कोठें असावी, हें ठरवावें. देव ओळखून आपला जीव त्याच्यापाशींच गुंतवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the gross body, this temple of `I am' and that atma, the God. Where do you place your conviction and understanding? One should recognize that God and `there' only one should place one's love.

owis.original: अंतरनिष्ठ ध्यान ऐसें । दंडकध्यान अनारिसें । प्रत्ययेविण सकळ पिसें । अनुमानध्यान ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आंतरनिष्ठेवर आधारलेले ध्यान हें असें असतें. दंडक ध्यान म्हणजे परंपरेनें चालत आलेंले जे ध्यान जें असतें तें याहून निराळे असते. त्या ध्यानांत अंतरात्म्याचा साक्षात अनुभव येत नाहीं. अशीं अनुमानावर आधारलेली ध्यानें म्हणजे सारा वेडेपणा होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Such inner steadfastness is real meditation. And the traditional meditation is quite different. Without that nirgun understanding, there is either the meditation on this `all' or the madness of conjecture.

owis.original: अनुमानें अनुमान वाढे । ध्यान धरितां सवेंचि मोडे । उगेचि कष्टति बापुडे । स्थूळध्यानें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पनेनें कल्पना वाढत जातें. आणि त्याबरोबरच जें ध्यान धरलेलें असतें तें मोडतें. स्थूलाचें ध्यान करण्यांत समान्य लोक बिचारे विनाकारण कष्ट करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: By conjecture, conjecture increases and then this meditation on the `all', gets im- mediately broken. Then that still and silent Self becomes a lost and helpless jiva and gets fatigued due to these gross meditations.

owis.original: देवास देहधारी कल्पिती । तेथें नाना विकल्प उठती । भोगणें त्यागणें विपत्ति । देहयोगें ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा ध्यानामध्ये देवाला देहधारी मानावें लागतेम. मग त्याठिकाणीं नाना विकल्प निर्माण होतात. देहाशी संबंध आला की भोग भोगणें, तो त्यागणें, संपत्ति व विपत्ति या सर्व गोष्टी येतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that One imagines God as the holder of a body (ie. a form) and then `there' (ie. the formless), `many' concepts arise. "Should I enjoy or should I renounce?" These thoughts arise, due to this calamity called body attachment. (That One imagines Itself to be a small ego and says, "I have a body, I am something" and it imagines God is also a body of some kind)

owis.original: ऐसें मनीं आठवतें । विचारितां भलतेंचि होतें । दिसों नये तें दिसतें । नाना स्वप्नीं ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या गोष्टीं मनांत येऊं लागल्या म्हणजे त्यावर विचार चालतो. विचार चालूं झाला म्हणजे कांहींतरी होते.स्वप्नांत असल्याप्रमाणें जें दिसूं नये तें दिसूं लागतें. ध्यान बाजूलाच राहाते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is such remembering in the mind then, to that thoughtless Self has come the `many' irrelevant thoughts only. That Reality which should not see then sees in this dream of the `many' (ie. our waking state).

owis.original: दिसतें तें सांगतां न ये । बळें भावार्थ धरितां नये । साधक कासाविस होये । अंतर्यामीं ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ध्यान करतांना जें दिसतें तें सांगतां येत नाहीं. बरें जें दिसतें त्यावर बळजबरीनें श्रद्धा ठेवता येत नाहीं. आणि  मग साधक मनांत कासावीस होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: As long as that One sees this world then, it cannot be thoughtless and firm faith cannot be held. Then the sadhak becomes very distressed in his inner space (ie. doubts and questions arise, "Am I there or am I not there?").

owis.original: सांगोपांग घडे ध्यान । त्यास साक्ष आपुलें मन । मनामध्यें विकल्पदर्शन । होऊंच नये ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सांगोपांग म्हणजे सर्व दृष्टीनें बरोबर ध्यान झालें कीं नाहीं, याची साक्ष आपलें स्वतःचे मनच देतें. ध्यान धरतांना मनांत एकही विकल्प न येतां ध्यान होणें हें सांगोपांग ध्यानाचें लक्षण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Our own mind is the witness to whether the meditation is being accomplished `without parts' (ie. thoughtless meditation). Therefore in the mind there should not be even the slightest idea or thought.

owis.original: फुटक मन येकवटिलें । तेणें तुटक ध्यान केलें । तेथें कोण सार्थक जालें । पाहाना कां ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळीकडे गुंतलेलें आपलें मन एखाद्यानें गोळा करुन ध्यान करण्याचा प्रयत्न केला तर मोडकें ध्यान लागेल. त्याचे सार्थक होणार नाहीं याचा तुम्हीच विचार करा.
owis.englishMeaning: If this aimless mind is gathered together, then still it is the broken making medi- tation. By such a meditation how can that meaning of life `there' be attained? Can you not understand this? (If the broken and incomplete meditates then, its meditation can only be broken and incomplete)

owis.original: अखंड ध्यानें न घडे हित । तरी तो जाणावा पतित । हाचि अर्थ सावचित । बरा पाहावा ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अखंड ध्यान करुन ज्याचे हित होत नाहीं तो पतित म्हणावयास हरकत नाहीं. पण असें होणें शक्य नाहीं. ही गोष्ट नीट विचारपूर्वक शोधून पहावी.
owis.englishMeaning: If unbroken meditation is not accomplished then, that Reality should be known as a `fallen' jiva. But thoughtlessness is the essence and this is a pure mind. Therefore one should understand this thoughtlessness.

owis.original: ध्यान धरितें तें कोण । ध्यानीं आठवतें तें कोण । दोनीमधें अनन्य लक्षण । असिलें पाहिजे ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ध्यान करतांना जो ध्यान धरतो तो आणि ज्याचे ध्यान धरलें जातें तो अशी दोन अंगें असतात. त्या दोन्हेमध्यें समरसता असणें ,त्यामधिल वेगळेपणा लोपणे व दोघें अनन्य होणें. हें ध्यानाचें प्रधान लक्षण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Who has that Reality to meditate upon? Who has that Reality to remember in meditation? Therefore within this purush/prakruti, the attention of no-otherness is required (first understand the otherness of the purush/prakruti and then understand no-otherness).

owis.original: अनन्य सहजचि आहे । साधक शोधून न पाहे । ज्ञानी तो विवरोन राहे । समाधानें ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वास्तविक ध्यान करणारा आणि अंतरात्मा दोघे मूळांत अनन्य आहेत. ही गोष्ट साधक शोधून बघत नाहीं. ज्ञानी पुरुष त्याचा शोध करुन अनन्यता अनुभवतो. आणि समाधानानें राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: No-otherness is natural. So as long as the sadhak searches for That then, That cannot be understood. Only the gnyani has understood That and He stays with complete contentment.

owis.original: ऐसीं हेप्रत्ययाची कामें । प्रत्ययेंविण बाधिजे भ्रमें । लोकदंडकसंभ्रमें । चालती प्राणी ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वानुभव घेण्याची पद्धती ही अशी आहे. आत्मप्रत्यय नसेल तर मात्र भ्रमाची बाधा होते. मग माणूस परंपरागत भ्रामक पद्धतीनें चालतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Thoughtlessness is the requirement for that nirgun understanding. Without that understanding there is this harmful action of delusion (ie. `all') and then, due to this false world of dreary and long traditions, that One passes time in the prana (this `all' is a remedy for it takes you out of the thoughts but, it is also harmful because from this original maya there comes the maya of ignorance and this brings body consciousness).

owis.original: दंडकध्यानाचें लक्षण । धरुन बैसलें अवलक्षण । प्रमाण आणि अप्रमाण । बाजारी नेणती ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परंपरागत पद्धतीनें ध्यान धरणें हें ध्यानाचें लक्षण नसून तें ध्यानाचें अवलक्षण आहे. भ्रमांत राहणारे लोक तेंच घट्ट धरुन बसतात. अगदी सामान्य लोकांना खरें ध्यान व खोटें ध्यान यांतील फरक कळत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: The attentions of traditional meditations that are held and maintained are the sinking into a bad habit. And then in this market place, one does not know the dif- ference between the unbroken and broken.14

owis.original: मिथ्या समाचार उठविती । वाउग्याच बोंबा घालिती । मनास आणितां अंतीं । आवघेंचि मिथ्या ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असें लोक खोट्या बातम्या, किंवा कल्पना किंवा मतें यांचा प्रसार करतात. निष्कारण आरडाओरड करतात. पण त्याचा मनानें शोध घेतला तर तें सगळें खोटें आहे असें लक्षांत येते.
owis.englishMeaning: False thinking has spread and a lot of bellowing is being made. And because of this, everything that is false has been brought to the mind.

owis.original: कोणीयेक ध्यानस्त बैसला । कोणीयेक सिकवी त्याला । मुकुट काढूनि माळ घाला । म्हणिजे बरें ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक माणूस ध्यानास बसला व तो मुकुटधारी मूर्तीचे ध्यान करुं लागला. मूर्तीच्या गळ्यांतील हार आखूड झाला. तेव्हां दुसर्‍यानें त्यास सुचविलें कीं अरें ! त्यांत काय मुकुट काढून गळ्यांत हार घाल म्हणजे झालें अशा प्रकारें ध्यान करणारा व त्याला युक्ति सुचविणारा दोघेही भ्रमांत वावरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That One within everyone was sitting lost in his thoughts and then that One within everyone gave instructions to his mind (ie. there is only that unbroken One; what need has That of thoughts. But when That gets broken then, `many' thoughts appear and there is this conversation or chattering in the mind). "Take off the crown and place a garland on the idol", it says.

owis.original: मनाचेथें काये दुष्काळ । जे आखुड कल्पिली माळ । सांगते ऐकते कोवळ । मूर्ख जाणावे ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जेथें मनानें नुसती कल्पनाच करायची आहे तेथें कल्पना करायला कांहीं लागत नाहीं. तरी ध्यान करणारा उगीचच आखूड हाराची खोटी कल्पना करतो. अशा ठिकाणीं सांगणारा व त्याचे ऐकणारा दोघेही मूर्ख समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is no famine of ideas and then, in the mind it was felt that the garland was too short (ie. in Reality there is no right/wrong, too short/too long; then what chattering will that One do?). Therefore by the foolish mind there should be this `listening' and then the thoughtless pure knowledge

owis.original: प्रत्यक्ष कष्ट करावे न लगती । दोरे फुलें गुंफावी न लगती । कल्पनेची माळ थिटी करिती । काये निमित्य ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनामध्यें ध्यान करतांना प्रत्यक्ष खटपट कांहींच करावी लागत नाहीं. प्रत्यक्ष दोरी घेऊन फुलें माळावी लागत नाहीत. असें असतांना कल्पनेनें रचलेली माळ आखूड करण्याचें कारणच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That One should not accept the distress of sensory experience. There is no need for That to get puffed up with pride or embarrass another due to this connection of body consciousness. Tell me, what is the reason for this string of meaningless thoughts? (maharaj- let them do whatever they like, why should you care?)

owis.original: बुधीविण प्राणी सकळ । ते ते अवघेचि बाष्कळ । तया मूर्खासीं खळखळ । कोणें करावी ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तात्पर्य अशी बुद्धिहीन माणसें सगळीं मूर्ख असतात. त्या मूर्खांना समजावण्यांत कांही अर्थ नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without the intellect/buddhi becoming this `all', that atma remains as a mind, licentious and wild in the prana on account of the `many' things. Why should the atma argue with this fool?

owis.original: जेणें जैसा परमार्थ केला । तैसाच पृथ्वीवरी दंडक चालिला । साता पाचांचा बळावला । साभिमान ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या पुरुषानें जसा परमार्थ केला असेल तशी त्याची परंपरा जगांत चालते. त्याला पांच सात अनुयायी मिळतात आणि ते त्याचा अभिमान धरतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever spiritual practices that have been made in this world were all based upon the tradition way of meditation and then this great pride of `I am' started to narrate `many' stories full of contradictions and inconsistencies (this meditation `I am' is still the traditional form of meditation, for still there is a meditator and object of meditation. But the nirgun understanding is quite different. `There' the meditator and the object to be meditated upon, does not remain).

owis.original: प्रत्ययेंविण साभिमान । रोगी मारिले झांकून । तेथें अवघाचि अनुमान । ज्ञान कैंचें ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या साधनाचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव येत नसून देखील त्याचा अभिमान धरणें योग्य नाहीं. औषधाचा गुण येत नसतांना रोग्यास झांकून ठेवून मारण्याचा प्रकार आहे. अशा ठिकाणीं सगळा कल्पनेचा गोंधळ असतो. ज्ञान असत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Without that nirgun understanding there is this great pride `I am' and when that purush catches this terrible disease, "I am a body" then, he is kept hidden away and finally ends up dying. How can this knowledge be `there', when there is the conjecture of everything?

owis.original: सर्व साभिमान सांडावा । प्रत्ययें विवेक मांडावा । माया पूर्वपक्ष खंडावा । विवेकबळें ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणून खर्‍या साधकानें सर्व संप्रदायांचा अभिमान सोडावा. अनुभव घेऊन मग विवेक मांडावा. आणि त्या विवेकाच्या बळावर मायेचा पूर्वपक्ष खंडून टाकावा, मायेचा निरास करुन परब्रह्माला स्पर्श करावा.
owis.englishMeaning: This great pride of the `all' therefore should also be left aside and through vivek that nirgun should be established. By such determined vivek, this original hypothesis of maya (`I am') should be eliminated. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Shashwat Nirupan (A Discourse on the Eternal)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पिंडाचें पाहिलें कौतुक । शोधिला आत्मानात्मा विवेक । पिंड अनात्मा आत्मा येक । सकळ कर्ता ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण पिंडाचें कौतुक पाहिलेम. आत्मानात्मविवेकानें पिंडरचना शोधून पाहिली. त्यांत असें प्रत्ययास आलें कीं, पिंड किंवा देह अनात्मा आहे आणि आत्मा एक आहे व सर्वकर्ता  आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this wonder (ie. `speech') within the gross body/pinda has been searched out and understood then, this is the vivek between the atma and non-atma. The pinda is non-atma and the atma is One, and the doer of `all' (ie. this atma is the moving antar-atma, see V. 13).

owis.original: आत्म्यास अनन्यता बोलिली । ते विवेकें प्रत्यया आली । आतं पाहिजे समजली । ब्रह्मांडरचना ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: "  मी आत्मा आहे " असें वेदांतशास्त्र सांगतें. विवेकानें त्याचा अनुभव आला. आतां ब्रह्माण्डरचना समजावून घेणें जरुर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: And when your `speech' is the no-otherness of that atma then, such vivek brings that nirgun understanding (then this antar-atma is paramatma). Therefore now, the structure of this brahmanda (ie. creation) should be understood (ie. drop all the thou- ghts that bring body consciousness).

owis.original: आत्मानात्माविवेक पिंडी । सारासारविचार ब्रह्मांडी । विवरविवरों हे गोडी । घेतली पाहिजे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडाची रचना समजण्यास आत्मानात्मविवेक लागतो तसा ब्रह्मांड रचना समजण्यास सारासार विचार लागतो. सतत असा विचार करीत गेलें म्हणजे त्याची गोडी चाखावयास मिळते.
owis.englishMeaning: The vivek of atma/ non-atma is within the pinda and that thoughtless essence is wi- thin the brahmanda. By the continuous investigation of this brahmanda, that sweet taste of thoughtlessness will be relished. (When you take youreself to be a body/pinda then atma/anatma vivek is required. Forget everything and just `listen'. Let your knowing wander freely and just `watch'. Then this body will simply merge in the brahmanda. Then there is only `I am' and now this knowledge needs to be submerged in that Reality)

owis.original: पिंड कार्य ब्रह्मांड कारण । याचें करावें विवरण । हेंचि पुढें निरुपण । बोलिलें असे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचभूतात्मक ब्रह्मांड हें पिंडाचें मूळकारण आहे. ब्रह्मांड कारण तर पिंड त्याचे कार्य आहे. याचें विवेरण करण्यासाठीं या समासांत तोच विषय सांगितला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the pinda as the result and the brahmanda as the *cause then, this `speech' should be made. Now, when there is the investigation of that nirgun then, this `speech' will be that thoughtless discourse. *(From the cause many effects arise. When you take yourself to be a body/pinda then, there is a world of `many' different forms outside of you ie. a brahmanda. When for example, you have the desire to taste a good cup of tea then, you experience only the sensation at the tip of your tongue and at that time, all the other incoming experiences, this fullness of life, is left aside. The sensation at the end of the tongue comes and goes; it is only a very small, momentary part of this knowledge of `all'. Therefore why should it be relished at the expense of your existence? Let whatever has to come, come but `I am not this experience, I don't know who I am, but I am not this'; neti, neti)

owis.original: असार म्हणिजे नासिवंत । सार म्हणिजे ते शाश्वत । जयास होईल कल्पांत । तें सार नव्हे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असार तें नाशवंत तर शाश्वत तें सार होय. ज्याचा आज ना उद्या नाश होतो तें सार नव्हे.
owis.englishMeaning: The non-essence should be called destructible. The essence should be called eternal. This mula maya will be destroyed, at the end of imagination, for it is not the essence.

owis.original: पृथ्वी जळापासून जाली । पुढें ते जळीं मिळाली । जळाची उत्पत्ती वाढली । तेजापासुनी ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाण्यापासून पृथ्वी झाली. पण पुढें ती पाण्यांत विरली. तेजापासूनच पाण्याची उत्पत्ती होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: The great element earth is created from the great element water and afterwards this earth again merges in the water. The issuing forth of this water came from the fire.

owis.original: तें जळ तेजें शोषिलें । महत्तेजे आटोन गेलें । पुढें तेजचि उरलें । सावकाश ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेज पाणी शोषून टाकतें. महातेजानें सारें पाणी आटून गेलें. पुढें तेज तेवढें काय तें उरलें.
owis.englishMeaning: And this water gets evaporated by the fire. Due to the great fire it wastes away and is destroyed. Afterwards, this wind remained as the fire only

owis.original: तेज जालें वायोपासुनी । वायो झडपी तयालागुनी । तेज जाउनी दाटणी । वायोचीच जाली ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायूपासून तेज झालें. वायु तेजाला विझवून टाकतो. मगतेज जाऊन वायु जिकडे तिकडे गच्च भरुन राहतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Fire was created from this wind and this wind blew and extinguished the fire. Then there was only this amassed wind (what is being described here is the act of objecti- fication which happens every day you awake. And also its dissolution.which happens every day when you go to sleep. Now this same dissolution should take place, while you are awake. This is called vivek)

owis.original: वायो गगनापासुनी जाला । मागुतां तेथेंचि विराला । ऐसा हा कल्पांत बोलिला । वेदांतशास्त्रीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायु आकाशापासून झालेला असतो. आणि फिरुन तो आकाशांतच विरतो. वेदान्त शास्त्रामध्यें कल्पांत कसा होतो त्याचे हें वर्णन आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The wind appeared from the sky and after, `there' only it dissolved. That is vedanta, the thoughtless `end of imagination' and it is within this `speech' of the shasthras. (From the shasthras this `speech' neti, neti can be understood and from vedanta there comes the end of this knowing and that is the thoughtless Self)

owis.original: गुणमाया मूलमाया । परब्रह्मीं पावती लया । तें परब्रह्म विवराया । विवेक पाहिजे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नंतर गुणमाया व मूळमाया या परब्रह्मामध्यें लय पावतात. त्या ब्रह्माची नीट कल्पना येण्यास विवेक आवश्यक आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This dissolution of gunamaya and mula maya takes place in parabrahman. To realize that parabrahman, the vivek of atma/anatma is first required.

owis.original: सर्व उपाधींचा सेवट । तेथें नाहीं दृश्य खटपट । निर्गुण ब्रह्म घनदाट । सकळां ठाईं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व उपाधींचा शेवट झाला म्हणजे तेथें दृश्यचा मागमूस उरत नाहीं. त्याठिकाणीं सगळीकडे गच्चपणें भरलेलें निर्गुण परब्रह्म असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this limiting concept of the `all' also comes to an end, for this busy activity of the moving visible is not `there'. Then that nirgun brahman completely fills this place of the `all'.

owis.original: उदंड कल्पांत जाला । तरी नाश नाहीं तयाला । मायात्यागें शाश्र्वताला । वोळखावें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठा कल्पांत होऊन सारें विश्र्व नाहींसें झालें तरी परब्रह्म नाश पावत नाहीं. मायेचा त्याग करुन अशा त्या शाश्वताला ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast paramatma appears at the `end of imagination' and That cannot be destroyed. That eternal should be recognized by the giving up of maya.

owis.original: देव अंतरात्मा सगुण । सगुणें पाविजे निर्गुण । निर्गुणज्ञानें विज्ञान । होत असे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा हा खरा देव आहे. तो सगुण आहे. त्याच्या आधारानें निर्गुणापर्यंत पोंचता येतें. निर्गुणाचें ज्ञान झालें कीं विज्ञान प्राप्त होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: God is the sagun antar-atma and due to this sagun, that nirgun is attained. Due to the knowledge of nirgun there is vignyan (ie. beyond knowledge).

owis.original: कल्पनेतीत जें निर्मळ । तेथें नाहीं मायामळ । मिथ्यत्वें दृश्य सकळ । होत जातें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मानवी कल्पनेच्या पलीकडे असणारें ब्रह्म अत्यंत निर्मळ आहे. त्याच्या ठिकाणीं मायेचा मल नाहीं. त्याच्या ठिकाणीं सारें दृश्य होतें आणि जातें. पण तें खोटेपणानें घडतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya is pure and beyond imagination then, it is brahman and there is no dirt of maya. Due to its being false, this visible `all' has come and gone.

owis.original: जें होतें आणि सवेंचि जाते । तें तें प्रत्ययास येतें । जेथें होणें जाणें नाहीं तें । विवेके वोळखावे ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें होतें आणि कालांतरानें नाहींसे होतें. तें  दृश्य अनुभवाला येते. पण परब्रह्मामध्यें होणें नाहीं व जाणें नाहीं. तें विवेकानें अनुभवास आणावें.
owis.englishMeaning: mula maya has come and of its own accord it has gone, bringing that nirgun 15siddharmeshwar maharaj- The Supreme Self meets anyone who wants to meet it. However maya meets Reality. This mula maya comes and goes for it is not that Reality; this should be recognized by vivek.

owis.original: येक ज्ञान येक अज्ञान । येक जाणावें विपरीत ज्ञान । हे त्रिपुटी होये क्षीण । तेंचि विज्ञान ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक ज्ञान व दुसरें अज्ञान आणि तिसरें विपरीत ज्ञान अशी हीं त्रिपुटी आहे. ही त्रिपुटी क्षीण झाली कीं विज्ञान प्रगट होतें.
owis.englishMeaning: That One is this knowledge (ie. sattwa) and that One is this ignorance (ie. tama) and that One should know this false changing knowledge (ie. worldly knowledge/rajo guna). And that thoughtless Self has become this triad of Knower, knowing, known and when this is destroyed there is vignyan.

owis.original: वेदांत सिधांत धादांत । याची पाहावी प्रचित । निर्विकार सदोदित । जेथें तेथें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वेदान्य, सिद्धान्त म्हणजे शास्त्र प्रततीति आणि धादांत म्हणजे आत्मप्रतीति या सार्‍या प्रचिती ताडून पाहाव्या. निर्विकार परब्रह्म निरंतर जसेच्या तसेंच असते. हेंच प्रचीतीला येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: That is vedanta, siddhant and dhadant (ie. own Self experience). But first the `speech' of this experience should be understood and then afterwards there is that unmodified/never-changing and ever-arisen `here' and `there'.

owis.original: तें ज्ञानदृष्टीनें पाहावें । पाहोन अनन्य राहावें । मुख्य आत्मनिवेदन जाणावें । याचें नांव ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परब्रह्म ज्ञानदृष्टीनें पाहावें. तें तसें पाहून त्याच्याशी तदाकार व्हावें. याला मुख्य आत्मनिवेदन म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That Reality should be understood through this `vision of knowledge'. Having un- derstood this then, that no-otherness should remain and never be broken. This `I am' should know that Supreme by surrendering to the atma.

owis.original: दृश्यास दिसतें दृश्य । मनास भासतो भास । दृश्यभासातीत अविनाश । परब्रह्म तें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्याला दृश्य दिसतें. मनाला भास होतो. पण परब्रह्म दृश्य आणि भास यांच्यापलीकडे अविनाशपणें असतें. असें अविनाशपणें राहणारें तेंच परब्रह्म होय.
owis.englishMeaning: To the visible, that Reality is seen as visible and then to the mind that Reality ap- pears as an appearance. Beyond the visible and appearance there is that indestructible parabrahman.

owis.original: पाहों जातां दुरीच्या दुरी । परब्रह्म सबाहेअंतरीं । अंतचि नाहीं अनंत सरी । कोणास द्यावी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्याच्या दृष्टीनें पाहायला गेलें, तर तें परब्रह्म कोठच्या कोठें दूर आहे असेम वाटते. पण तें सर्व ठिकाणीं आंत बाहेर भरलेले आहे. तें अनंत आहें. त्यास कोठेंच अंत नाहीं. त्याची बरोबरी करणारी वस्तूच विश्वामध्यें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: If you try to see it then, That is the furthest of the far (when you are there that Reality cannot be understood). But that parabrahman is inside and outside of this inner space. That which has no end is that endless paramatma. Who or what can be everyone, even if one does not want to meet her. Its equal?

owis.original: चंचळ तें स्थिरावेना । निश्र्चळ तें कदापी चळेना । आभाळ येतें जातें गगना । चळण नाहीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें चंचळ असतें तें कधीं स्थिरपणानें राहात नाहीं. जें निश्चळ असतें त्यांत कधीं अस्थिरपणा असत नाहीं. आकाशामध्यें आभाळ येतें व जातें तरी आकाश जसेंच्या तसेंच राहातें. असेंच परब्रह्म निष्चळ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This moving cannot be that still Reality and that still can never move. It is just like when the clouds come and go and the sky does not move.

owis.original: जें विकारें वाढे मोडे । तेथें शाश्वतता कैंची घडे । कल्पांत होताच विघडे । सकळ कांहीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्यामध्येम विकार होतो आणि त्यामुळें जें वाढतें आणि मोडतें, त्याच्या बाबतींत शाश्वतपणाची अपेक्षा करता येत नाहीं. कल्पांतसमयीं विकारशील सारें पार नाश पावतें.
owis.englishMeaning: mula maya grows and breaks because it is a modification. How can that happen to the eternal `there'? When there is the `end of imagination' then, this `all thing' (ie. knowledge) gets extinguished.

owis.original: जें अंतरींच भ्रमलें । मायासंभ्रमें संभ्रमलें । तयास हें कैसे उकले । आव्हान चक्र ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या अंतर्यामी भ्रमाचें ठाण आहे, मायेच्या अमलानें जें गोंधळून गेलें आहेत, त्यांना हें विलक्षण अवघड चक्र उकलणें शक्य नाहीं. भ्रमानें पछाडलेल्या माणसांना हीं अवघड समस्या सुटत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya is bewildered within its own inner space then, it is the `many' and it respects this bewildering maya. How then can that thoughtless Self be known when it moves through the back-streets of the mind?

owis.original: भिडेनें वेव्हार निवडेना । भिडेनें सिधांत कळेना । भिडेनें देव आकळेना । आंतर्यामीं ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दृश्याच्या दडपणानें भ्रमांत राहणार्‍या माणसाला व्यवहाराचें स्वरुप कळत नाहीं. त्याच दडपणानें त्याला शास्त्रसिद्धांत काय आहें तेही कळत नाहीम. आणि त्याच दडपणानें अंतर्यामी राहणारा अंतरात्मा त्याला आकलन होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is fear and regard for maya then, the troubles cannot ever be settled. Due to such fear and regard, that siddhant is not known. Due to fear and regard, that God (ie. antaratma) within the heart is not recognized.

owis.original: वैद्याची प्रचित येईना । आणि भीडहि उलंघेना । तरी मग रोगी वांचेना । ऐसें जाणावें ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रोगी वैद्याचें औषध घेतो आहे पण गुण येत नाहीं भिडेंने तो दुसर्‍या वैद्याकडेही जात नाही. असा रोगी कांहीं वाचत नाहीं हे समजून चालावें.
owis.englishMeaning: You should know that if this `I am' experience is not with the *doctor and one does not leave him out of fear and regard then, that one who is diseased will not live through such difficulty. *(A doctor agrees that you are a body and therefore he cannot stop you from dying)

owis.original: जेणें राजा वोळखिला । तो राव म्हणेना भलत्याला । जेणें देव वोळखिला । तो देवरुपी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो राजाला बरोबर ओळखतो तो भलत्यालाच राजा म्हणणार नाहीं. त्याचप्रमाणें जो देवाला बरोबर ओळखतो तो भलत्यालाच देव म्हणणार नाहीं. तो स्वतः देवरुपच बनून जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when due to mula maya, the King is recognized then, He will not call another the King. When due to mula maya, God is recognized then mula maya becomes just like God.

owis.original: जयास माईकाची भीड । तें काये बोलेल द्वाड । विचार पाहातां उघड । सकळ कांहीं ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला मायिक दृश्याची भीड पडतें, जो दृश्याच्या तडाख्यांत असतो, तो अर्धवट, देवाबद्दल बरोबर सांगणें शक्य नाहीं. आपण विचार केला तर या सर्व गोष्टी उघडपणें कळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that purush has regard or fear for illusion then, what falsity will that `speak'? But when thoughtlessnesss is understood, then this `all thing' is opened out and set free.

owis.original: भीड मायेऐलीकडे । परब्रह्म तें पैलीकडे । पैलीकडे ऐलीकडे । सदोदित ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मायेचे दडपण अलीकडे आहे. परब्रह्म मात्र मायेच्या पलीकडे आहे. माया अलीकडे व परब्रह्म पलीकडे हा कायमचा प्रकार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Regard is on this side with maya and parabrahman is the other side. Still the other side and this side are that ever-arisen One only (in truth, this and that side don't remain).

owis.original: लटिक्याची भीड धरणें । भ्रमें भलतेंचि करणें । ऐसी नव्हेंती लक्षणें । विवेकाचीं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें खरें नाहीं त्याची भीड धरायची मायेच्या भ्रमानें भलतेंच कांहीं तरी करायचे, हीं कांहीं विवेकाची लक्षनें खासच नाहींत.
owis.englishMeaning: To hold on to this regard for the false and to do something is due to delusion (ie. this `all', see V.1). Like this is this vivek of that which never was (ie. this vivek of atma/anatma is also otherness; it is the attention of mula maya and not the Truth)

owis.original: खोटें अवघेंचि सांडावें । खरें प्रत्ययें वोळखावें । मायात्यागें समजावें । परब्रह्म ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें मायिकआहे, खोटें आहें, तें सगळेंच्या सगळें सोडावें. स्वतः अनुभव घेऊन खरें काय तें ओळखावें. मायेचा त्याग करुन परब्रह्माचें दर्शन घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: The false that has created these `many' things should be left aside. That Truth, which is due to the nirgun should be recognized. Therefore by giving up maya, pa- rabrahman should be understood.

owis.original: तें मायेचें जें लक्षण । तेंचि पुढें निरुपण । सुचितपणें विवरण । केलें पाहिजे ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या मायेचे लक्षण पुढच्या समासांत नीट सांगितलें आहे. शांत मनानें त्याचे विवरण करावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When that Reality has the attention of mula maya then, that Reality has become this sagun discourse. Therefore ahead the investigation of that essence/non-essence should be made with a pure mind. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: माया दिसे परी नासे । वस्तु न दिसे परी न नासे । माया सत्य वाटे परी मिथ्या असे । निरंतर ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माया दिसते पण ती नाश पावते. सद्वस्तु म्हणजे परब्रह्म दिसत नाहीं. पण तें कधीहीं नाश पावत नाहीं. माया मनाला सत्य वातते, पण ती निरंतर किंवा सदैव खोटी असते.
owis.englishMeaning: maya appears but it is destroyed. The Self does not appear but it is not destroyed. maya is felt to be true but it is false and there is always that parabrahman .

owis.original: करंटा पडोनी उताणा । करी नानापरी कल्पना । परी तें कांहींच घडेना । तैसी माया ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक करंटा माणूस उताणा पडून आकाशाकडे पाहात निरनिराळ्या कल्पना करतो, पण त्सें कांहींच घडत नाहीं. माया अशीच असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: The lost and destitute reclines on his back and *imagines so `many' things. But then he will never even accomplish this `thing'. For such is maya. *(Lying on our back or at work, we daydream our life away and sustain this body thought. But if we can drop these thoughts then, we become knowledge)

owis.original: द्रव्यदारेचें स्वप्नवैभव । नाना विळासें हावभाव । क्षणीक वाटे परी माव । तैसी माया ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका माणसाला स्वप्न पडले. त्यांत त्यांनें बायकोसहीत मोठे वैभव पाहिले. नाना प्रकारचे विलास व भोग पाहिले. स्वप्नापुरते तें खरें वाटतात. पण तो सगळा भास असतो. माया अशीच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: In the glory of this original dream (ie. `I am') there has appeared wealth and woman and the `many' wanton passions and imaginations. They arise momentarily for they are fraudulent. For such is maya.

owis.original: गगनीं गंधर्वनगरें । दिसताती नाना प्रकारें । नाना रुपें नाना विकारें । तैसी माया ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशांत नाना प्रकारची गंधर्वनगरें, निरनिराळे आकार दिसतात. त्यांत अनेक रुपें व अनेक विकार दिसतात. पण तो नुसता देखावा असतो. माया अशीच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the ways of the `many' (ie. imagination) there is the appearance of the cities of gandhava in the sky (ie. just close your eyes and in that space/nothingness you can imagine everything ie. day dream of woman as beautiful as angels and heroes and mansions etc. etc.). There are `many' forms and `many' changes, for such is maya.

owis.original: लक्षुमी रायेविनोदाची । बोलतां वाटे साची । मिथ्या प्रचित तेथीची । तैसी माया ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा बहुरुपी असतो. तो श्रीमंताचें सोंग घेऊन ऐश्वर्याच्या गोष्टी बोलतो. तो बोलतो तेव्हां त्या खर्‍या वाटतात. पण त्या अनुभवाला कांहीं येत नाहींत. त्या खोट्या असतात. माया अशीच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The wealth of the one who has donned this disguise (ie. a gross body) is this `speech' and then, it is felt to be the Truth. But this sagun experience is false within `there'. Such is maya.

owis.original: दसर्‍याचे सुवर्णाचे लाटे । लोक म्हणती परी ते कांटे । परी सर्वत्र राहाटे । तैसी माया ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दसर्‍याच्या दिवशीं सोनें लुटतात. लोक त्यास सोनें म्हणतात. पण तीं अपट्याची पानें असतात. त्याला काटे असतात. सर्वत्र हीच पद्धत आहे. माया अशीच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: During the festival of dasara people exchange *leaves of gold with each other. Then they say, "Accept this gold", but then, that Reality has become but a thorny bush. Everywhere such exchanges are going on; for such is this maya (due to imagination, the whole world gives name and form to so `many' things and then that Reality appears as these `many' things). *(The custom on this day is to exchange the leaves of a thorn bush with each other. They say that these are pieces of gold and this is believed to bring good fortune)

owis.original: मेल्याचा मोहोछाव करणें । सतीचें वैभव वाढवणें । मसणीं जाउनी रुदन करणें । तैसी माया ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या प्रेताचा मोठा उत्सव करणें, सती निघालेल्या बाईचे वैभव वाढविणें, स्मशानांत जाऊन रडणें, तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: They make a grand ceremony for the dead (ie. this body is a dead body at the moment and for that we have so many occasions) and due to demonic possession, they glorify the sati. This is maya (ie. due to possession by the ego, people glorify the wife who will burn herself on the funeral pyre along with her dead husband. And due to the ego also, she immolates herself). Then they go to the burning grounds and wail and cry.16 Like this is maya. (All this is is due to the great misunderstanding, "I am a body and I have to die")

owis.original: राखेसी म्हणती लक्षुमी । दुसरी भारदोरी लक्षुमी । तिसरी नाममात्र लक्षुमी । तैसी माया ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ठेवलेल्या बाईला लक्ष्मी म्हणतात. गर्भपात न व्हावा म्हणून मंत्रानें भारलेली दोरी तिच्या कमरेला बांधतात. त्या भारदोरीला लक्ष्मी म्हणतात. तिसरी नावाची लक्ष्मी. यापैकी खरी लक्ष्मी एकही नाहीं. अशी ही माया असते.
owis.englishMeaning: A prostitute may be called lakshmi (ie. vishnu's chaste consort or prakruti) and the name of a charm tied around a woman's waist, to protect the unborn child, is also called lakshmi. And the third lakshmi is this `I am' feeling. But all this is maya.

owis.original: मुळीं बाळविधवा नारी । तिचें नांव जन्मसावित्री । कुबेर हिंडे घरोघरीं । तैसी माया ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादी बालविधवा असते पण तिचे नाव मात्र जन्मसावित्री. आडनांव कुबेर पण दारोदार भीक मागत हिंडतो. अशी माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: In childhood a girl was betrothed to a boy and this boy dies and she becomes a child widow. Yet her *`name' means, one who will never be a widow. And kuber, the treasurer of the god's wealth (ie. `I am') has become a beggar who wanders from house to house. Like this is maya. (Though we are kuber and we have this great treasure of `I am', still He wanders from one body to the next asking the things of the world to make him happy) *(Her real `name' means `I am' and this `I am' is the consort of narayan and He is eternal and can never die. Thus she can never be a widow. But if she takes herself to be a body then, man, women, birth, death etc. are all taken as true)

owis.original: दशअवतारांतील कृष्णा । उपजे जीर्ण वस्त्रांची तृष्णा । नदी नामें पीयुष्णा । तैसी माया ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दशावतारांचा खेळ करणारा माणूस कृष्णाचे सोंग घेऊन द्रौपदीला खूप वस्त्रें पुरवितो. पण ते झाल्यावर लोकांपाशी लगेच जुनेंपानें वस्त्र मागतो. बेताचे पाणी असलेली एखादी नदी असते, पण तिचें नांव असतें पियूष्णा म्हणजे अमृताची नदी. तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the *ten incarnations of vishnu/knowing there is Lord krishna. But He gets born with the desire to wear some old garments (ie. we are krishna but we take this body of flesh and blood as our own and adorn that with beautiful things). Due to this `name'/`I am', a river becomes this immortal nectar when seen with these eyes of knowledge; still this is maya (when one understands knowledge then, river, sea, wave etc. are the one water ie. names and thus forms have been left aside and there is this immortal nectar of `I am') *(maharaj the ten incarnations are the ten senses)

owis.original: बहुरुपांतील रामदेवराव । ग्रामस्तांपुढे दाखवी हावभाव । कां माहांराज म्हणोनि लाघव । तैसी माया ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादा बहुरुपी रामदेव रामदेव राजाचें सोंग घेतो आणि गावकर्‍यांच्या समोर महाराजांप्रमाणें उत्तम हावभाव करतो. आपलें अभिनय कौशल्य दाखवितो. तशीही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Among these `many' forms there is Lord ram and in the village play he makes a great performance. But why is that real King (ie. Lord ram) given no importance? Like this is maya. (Lord ram plays within everyone but He is forgotten and we assume these many roles. But this world is just like a village play if we understood; maharaj- act well on your part, for there the honour lies)

owis.original: देव्हारां असे अन्नपूर्णा । आणी गृहीं अन्नचि मिळेना । नामें सरस्वती सिकेना । शुभावळु ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घरांतील देव्हार्‍यामध्यें अन्नपूर्णा आहे. पण घरांत खायला अन्न नाहीं. बाईचे नांव आहे सरस्वती. पण ती विद्याभ्यास करीत नाहीं. नुसत्या गोवर्‍या थापते. तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this house (ie. body) there is this image of God and it is called annapurna (ie. full of `food'/`I am'), yet in this house one does not even get enough to eat (though having this divine `food' within, we take ourselves to be a body and then, we are always looking for something to fill the belly and are never satisfied. Only this `I am', the image of God can full us. In the morning bhajans it says, "When I see your face/form then, hunger and thrist are destroyed"). Due to this `name' there is saraswati but she has become a simple village woman who makes only cow-dung cakes. Such is maya. (saraswati, the goddess of knowledge resides within us all but this `name'/knowledge has not been searched out and understood and so there is body consciousness)

owis.original: सुण्यास व्याघ्र नाम ठेविलें । पुत्रास इंद्रनामें पाचारिलें । कुरुप परी आळविलें । सुंदरा ऐसें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या कुत्र्याचे नांव ठेवलें वाघ्या. इंद्र नावानें मुलाला हांक मारली. एखाद्या कुरुप स्त्रीचे सुंदरा म्हणून लाड केलें तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `name' is the tiger upon which maya rides but she has been forgotten and there is this dog (ie. the splendour of mula maya/`I am' is within every creature but this has been left aside and we wander around like a dog always looking for something). This `name' is indra the Lord of the senses, but He has been summoned to become someone's son (ie. that Lord of the senses is within everyone but he has been forgotten and on account of desires he is forced into the confines of the body). Then there is this ugly form, but indra should be recognized and then everything will be beautiful.

owis.original: मूर्ख नामें सकळकळा । राशभी नामें कोकिळा । नातरी डोळसेचा डोळा । फुटका जैसा ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या मूर्खाला सकल कलावंत म्हणावें, गाढवी ओरडू लागली कीं तीला कोकिळा म्हणावें, फुटक्या डोळ्याच्या माणसाला डोळस किंवा सुंदर डोळ्याचा म्हणावें, तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: A fool due to this `name' becomes this `art of the knowing' (ie. forget everything and what remains is this knowing). A female donkey due to this `name', sings like a beautiful song bird (when `I am everything, everywhere' then everything is beautiful. A Saint once said that when you understand then, the sound of a barking dog is more harmonious than a Beethoven symphony). And without this `name' the eyes of the sharp-sighted (ie. atma) are weak or even blind. Like this is maya.

owis.original: मातांगीचें नाम तुळसी । चर्मिकेचें नाम कासी । बोलती अतिशूद्रिणीसी । भागीरथी ऐसें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या मांगिणीचें नांव तुळशी, चांभारणीचें नांव काशी किंवा अतिशूद्रीणीचे नांव भागिरथी असावें, अशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This `name' is tulsi and it has become a woman from the shameful matangi caste (ie. mati-dust, anga-body) (maharaj- tulsi means you should be dissolved). And this `name' is kashi and it has become a woman who belongs to the caste that makes leather things (ie. these bodies of skin) (maharaj- kashi is the place of shiva). But when she knows this `speech' that is within the lowest shuddhra caste when the `name' ganga is fitting (ie. the shruddhra is body consciousness but her `name' is ganga, the river of knowledge).

owis.original: साउली आणी अंधकार । येक होतां तेथीचा विचार । उगाचि दिसे भासमात्र । तैसी माया ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सावली आणि अंधार एकत्र मिसळले तर काय होते याचा विचार करावा. यांत जें कांहीं दिसतें तें भासमात्र असतें. तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: These shadows and this darkness of ignorance become that One when there is thoughtlessness within `there'. But where there is wrong thinking then only `many' appearances are seen. Like this is maya.

owis.original: श्रवण बोटें संधी करतळा । रविरश्में दिसती इंगळा । रम्य आरक्तकल्होळ । तैसी माया ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपलें कान, बोटें, सांधें, तळहात हे सूर्याच्या प्रकाशांत निखार्‍यासारखें लाल दिसतात. तो लालपणा खरा नसतो. तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The ears, fingers, joints and palms of the hand are seen, due to the sun's rays (ie. due to this knowingness, a body is seen. Then you who are without parts, is this body of `many' different parts) and then there is the strong arising of passion for the sense objects. For such is this maya.

owis.original: भगवें वस्त्र देखतां मनाला । वाटे अग्नचि लागला । विवंचितां प्रत्ये आला । तैसी माया ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्यानें छान भगवें वस्त्र घातलेले दिसलें तर त्याच्या अंगाला आग लागली आहे असा भास होतो. पण नीट निरीक्षण केल्यावर तें तसेम नाहीं हेम पटतें. तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When the mind sees the saffron clothes of a sannyasi it feels that the fire of knowledge is burning there (maharaj- putting on saffron clothes and wearing mala beads does not make one a sannyasa). But only thoughtlessness can bring that nirgun understanding. Like this is maya.

owis.original: जळीं चरणकरांगुळें । आखुड लांबें किरकोळें । विपरीत काणें दिसती जळें । तैसी माया ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हाताची बोटें पाण्यांत बुडविली तर आखूड, लांब, बारीक, विचित्र, वांकडी अशी दिसतात. पाण्यामुळें ती तशीं दिसतात. माया तशी आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Within these great elemental waters there are the bent feet and fingers, long and thin. For due to these waters there is a limited vision caused by objectification and one sees the false. maya is like this. (The great waters are the beginning of names and forms and then a gross body appears)

owis.original: भोवंडीनें पृथ्वी कलथली । कामिणीनें पिवळी जाली । सन्यपातस्थां अनुभवली । तैसी माया ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भोवळ आलेल्या माणसाला पृथ्वी फिरल्यासारखीं वाटते. कावीळ झालेल्या माणसाला ती पिवळी दिसते. सन्नितापाचा ताप आलेल्या माणसाला  ती कांहींच्या कांहीं अनुभवास येते. तशी ही माया आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: By spinning around one becomes giddy and staggers around this world (ie. by running needlessly around). Due to hepatitis everything appears yellow (but is the world really like this?) and due to a high fever many strange things are experienced. maya is just like this.

owis.original: कोणीयेक पदार्थविकार । उगाचि दिसे भासमात्र । अनन्याचा अन्य प्रकार । तैसी माया ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखाद्या पदार्थाचें मूळ स्वरुप एकअसतें. त्यामध्यें कांहीं बदल झाल्यानें तें निराळें आहे असा उगीच भास होतो. म्हणजे वस्तु एक असून निराळीच कांहींतरी दिसतें. माया तशी आहे. विश्र्व ब्रह्मस्वरुप असून दृश्यपणें दिसतें, मायेमुळें असें घडते.
owis.englishMeaning: That One (ie. purush) within this `all' has become this modified `object' (ie. prakruti) and then due to wrong thinking, `many' appearances are seen. Whenever there are the separate forms in that inseparable brahman then, this is maya! .
